powers.name: QUICKDRAW 7
powers.text: When "Blink" Dawson is chosen as a target for a normal attack from an enemy figure within 7 clear sight spaces that is not adjacent, you may immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 7 or higher, the attacking figure takes 1 wound and the attack immediately ends.

units.name: 10th Regiment of Foot
units.set: Defenders of Kinsland: Soldiers and Wolves

powers.name: WAIT THEN FIRE
powers.text: If none of the 10th Regiment of Foot move this turn, add 1 die to their attack

powers.name: MELEE DEFENSE 1
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his defense dice.

powers.name: BAYONET ATTACK 1
powers.text: When rolling attack dice against an adjacent figure, a Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot adds 1 to his attack dice. A Soldier in the 10th Regiment of Foot can only use Bayonet Attack if he moved at least one space this turn.

powers.name: GAS GRENADE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Lob 12. Attack 1. Before attacking normally, one 12th Caucasus Rifle Soldier may choose a figure to attack with Gas Grenade Special Attack. No clear line of sight is needed. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Gas Grenade Special Attack. Roll one attack die once for all affected figures. If you roll a skull, all figures affected by Gas Grenade Special Attack subtract 1 from their defense dice for the entire turn. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Gas Grenade Special Attack never affects destructable objects or 12th Caucasus Rifles.

powers.name: HOLD GROUND
powers.text: If there is only one unrevealed Order Marker on any 20th Maine Volunteers army card you control, all 20th Maine Volunteers you control add 2 to their defense dice.

powers.name: DOWNHILL ATTACK
powers.text: A 20th Maine Volunteer with a height advantage on an adjacent opponent's figure rolls an additional attack die when attacking that figure.

powers.name: WAIT THEN FIRE
powers.text: If none of the 4th Massachusetts Line move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.

powers.name: VALIANT ARMY DEFENSE BONUS
powers.text: If every Army Card you control has a Valiant personality, each soldier in the 4th Massachusetts Line receives 1 additional defense die.

powers.name: STEADY AIM
powers.text: If none of the 53rd North Carolina Sharpshooters move this turn, add 2 to their range.

powers.name: CRACK SHOT
powers.text: A 53rd North Carolina Sharpshooter receives an additional attack die when attacking a figure that is at least 4 spaces away.

powers.name: MARCHING ORDERS
powers.text: When revealing an Order Marker on the Army Card of a Unique Soldier Hero you control that follows Jandar, and after taking that Unique Soldier Hero's turn, you may move each 8th Infantry Pathfinder figure you control up to 5 spaces. A Pathfinder must be able to move adjacent to a Unique Soldier figure you control that follows Jandar in order to use Marching Orders.

powers.name: FIREFIGHT
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on an 8th Infantry Pathfinder, instead of taking a turn with a Pathfinder, you may choose up to three Pathfinders you control. One at a time, take a turn with each Pathfinder. During these turns, the chosen Pathfinders may not move.

powers.name: SUPER LEAP
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Abomination may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Abomination's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Abomination may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Abomination may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Abomination is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Abomination rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.

powers.name: STOMP SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 1 Attack 3
All figures adjacent to Abomination are also affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Abomination cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses his Super Leap.

powers.name: SKEWER
powers.text: When an Achillean Gladiatrix attacks an adjacent figure, you may choose one small or medium figure that is adjacent to the defending figure but is not adjacent to that Achillean Gladiatrix. If the defending figure is destroyed by that Achillean Gladiatrix's attack, the chosen figure receives one wound.

powers.name: JAVELIN
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with an Achillean Gladiatrix, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, add 3 to that Achillean Gladiatrix's Range value for the duration of her turn.

powers.name: LEAF OF THE HOME TREE AURA
powers.text: When any Elf you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Acolarh receives enough wounds to be destroyed, you may roll 10 Ullar Valkyrie dice before removing the figure. If you roll at least 3 Ullar symbols, ignore any wounds that figure just received. Acolarh's Leaf of the Home Tree Aura does not affect Acolarh.

powers.name: ULLAR'S AMULET
powers.text: All friendly figures who follow Ullar and start their turn adjacent to Acolarh may move 2 additional spaces.

powers.name: BLOOD SUMMONING
powers.text: At the start of the game, you may choose any or all Unique Demon Heroes you control to be Bound Heroes of the Acolytes of Vorganund. Place those Heroes on this card. Once per turn, instead of moving normally with an Acolyte of Vorganund, you may destroy that Acolyte and place a Bound Hero from this card on the space that Acolyte occupied.

powers.name: DARK PACT
powers.text: After taking a turn with the Acolytes of Vorganund, you may take a turn with a Bound Hero you control. If you do, and a figure other than the Bound Hero received wounds or was destroyed during the Bound Hero's turn, nothing happens. Otherwise, destroy an Acolyte of Vorganund you control.

powers.name: ADMIRAL'S ORDERS
powers.text: After rolling for Initiative, you may move any Order Markers from this card onto any of your Pirate or Captain Army Cards.

powers.name: BOARDING PARTY SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 2 + Special.
You may attack up to 4 times with Boarding Party Special Attack. Roll one additional attack die when attacking a figure engaged with a Pirate or Captain you control. After each attack, if that was the first time you attacked the defending figure this turn, you may move one Pirate or Captain figure you control up to 4 spaces. You may not move the same figure more than once in a turn using Boarding Party Special Attack.

powers.name: WARDEN STRATEGIC BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Aetherion City Guard, you may first take a turn with a Warden Hero you control. If you do, add 1 to the Aetherion City Guards’ Attack and none of them may move during their turn. If you do not, then you may move with up to 4 Aetherion City Guards you control and attack with any 2 of those Aetherion City Guards during their turn.

powers.name: ESOTERIC TRAINING 12
powers.text: When an Aetherion City Guard would receive one or more wounds from a special attack or a special power on any Army Card or Glyph, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.

powers.name: MAGICK RESTRAINTS
powers.text:
An opponent’s large or huge figure that is adjacent to at least two Aetherion City Guards you control
at the start of a turn subtracts 1 from its Attack and Defense and 3 from its Move number for the remainder of that turn.

powers.name: GHOST WALK
powers.text: Agent Carr can move through all figures.

powers.name: SWORD OF RECKONING 4
powers.text: If Agent Carr is attacking an adjacent figure, add 4 dice to Agent Carr's attack.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: CRIPPLING GLANCE 15
powers.text: Before moving normally, you may choose a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Agent Carr. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card.

powers.name: SWORD OF RECKONING 4
powers.text: Add 4 to Agent Carr's Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Agent Carr is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: BULLET STORM SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 3.
Choose 6 spaces in a straight line from Agent Nora. Choose one figure within clear line of sight on those spaces to attack with Bullet Storm Special Attack. When using Bullet Storm Special Attack, Agent Nora may attack up to 6 times, but must choose a different 6 spaces in a straight line each time.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Agent Nora can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: OBFUSCATION MATRIX
powers.text: SI-4X's spaces and all spaces within 1 of SI-4X are considered shadow spaces in addition to their other terrain types.

powers.name: PHANTOM PROTOCOLS
powers.text: Revna and Vydar figures you control that start their movement on a shadow space can move through all figures and do not take leaving engagement attacks during that movement.

powers.name: SHADOW ASSASSIN
powers.text: While SI-4X is attacking a Hero or Squad figure that is on a shadow tile, all skulls in the attack roll count for one additional skull.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Agent Skahen attacks, she may attack one additional time.

powers.name: COVER FIRE
powers.text: When attacking an opponent's figure, if Agent Skahen inflicts one or more wounds, you may move one Tricky figure you control who follows Vydar and is within 8 clear sight spaces of Agent Skahen up to 4 spaces. You cannot use Cover Fire to move Agent Skahen.

powers.name: STEALTH DODGE
powers.text: When Agent Skahen rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

powers.name: WHIRLWIND ATTACK
powers.text: Agrith-Naar may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

powers.name: STARVED
powers.text: At the end of Agrith-Naar's turn, if he did not destroy a Hero or Squad figure with his normal attack during that turn, you must place a wound marker on his Army Card.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Agrith-Naar's movement, ignore elevations. Agrith-Naar may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Agrith-Naar starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Air Elemental
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Fury of the Primordials

powers.name: SWIRLING VORTEX
powers.text: When an opponent's small or medium figure moves into a space within 2 clear sight spaces of an Air Elemental you control, that figure must end its move there. Figures can never move through any figure affected by Swirling Vortex.

powers.name: AIR MASTERY
powers.text: Figures that have the Flying or Stealth Flying special power subtract 1 from their defence dice when attacked by an Air Elemental.

powers.name: STEALTH FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for an Air Elemental's movement, ignore elevations. An Air Elemental may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Air Elemental starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Air Marshal Zed Nesbitt
units.set: Boiling Tensions: Air Marshal Zed Nesbitt

powers.name: SKYHOOK
powers.text: After Air Marshal Zed Nesbitt finishes moving, if he used the Flying Special Power during this movement, you may choose any number of friendly Small or Medium Vorids that Nesbitt passed over this turn. Place those figures adjacent to Nesbitt. Figures moved with Skyhook never take leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: CRASH LANDING SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 5. Nesbitt can only use Crash Landing Special Attack if he used the Flying Special Power this turn. All figures adjacent to Nesbitt are affected by Crash Landing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After using Crash Landing Special Attack, you must place one Wound Maker on this Army Card, and Nesbitt cannot move normally for the rest of the round.

powers.name: GRENADE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Lob 12. Attack 2. Use this power once per game. Start the game with a grenade marker on this card. Remove the grenade marker to throw grenades. One at a time do the following with each Airborne Elite: Choose a figure to attack. No clear line of sight is needed. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Grenade Special Attack. Roll 2 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: THE DROP
powers.text: Airborne Elite do not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of each round, before you place order markers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may place all 4 Airborne Elite figures on any empty spaces. You cannot place them adjacent to each other or other figures, or on Glyphs.

powers.name: DEMONBLADE
powers.text: For every opponent's figure Akumaken destroys, place a Soul Marker on this card. Before attacking with Akumaken, you may remove any number of Soul Markers from this card. For each marker removed, add 1 automatic skull to whatever is rolled. A maximum of 2 Soul Markers can be placed on this card. Akumaken cannot use Demonblade on destructible objects.

powers.name: MASK OF TERROR
powers.text: When a Squad figure adjacent to Akumaken attacks using a normal attack, it subtracts 1 from its attack dice. Figures with the fearless personality are not affected by Mask of Terror.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against Samurai.

units.name: Alastair MacDirk
units.set: Champions of Jandar Remastered, Jandar's Oath: Heroes of Nostralund

powers.name: OVEREXTEND ATTACK
powers.text: After taking a turn with Alastair MacDirk, you may place a wound marker on Alastair MacDirk and take another turn with him. You may only use this power once during a round.

powers.name: INSECT STRATEGIC BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Amberhive Protectors, you may first take a turn with any Insect Hero you control. If you do not take a turn with any Insect Hero you control, you may move and attack with up to 6 Amberhive Protectors you control.

powers.name: SACRIFICIAL STING SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 4. When attacking a figure within 4 spaces of an Insect Hero you control, an Amberhive Protector may use Sacrificial Sting Special Attack. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Sacrificial Sting Special Attack, destroy the attacking Amberhive Protector.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for an Amberhive Protector's movement, ignore elevations. An Amberhive Protector may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Amberhive Protector starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: TURN UNDEAD SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 4. Attack 4. Turn Undead Special Attack can be used to attack only Undead figures.

powers.name: PROTECTION FROM EVIL AURA
powers.text: All small or medium figures you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Ana Karithon add 1 to their defense dice when rolling defense against an attack from a figure who follows Utgar. Ana Karithon's Protection from Evil Aura does not affect Ana Karithon.

powers.name: HEALING WORD
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on a wounded small or medium Hero figure you control that is adjacent to Ana Karithon, and before using any other special powers on any Army Card or Glyph, you may first roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove up to 2 wound markers from that Hero's Army Card.

powers.name: UNLEASHED FURY
powers.text:
Before moving, roll the 20-sided die.
• If you roll a 1, choose an Anubian Wolf you control and destroy it.
• If you roll a 2–6, add 1 to the Attack value of this card.
• If you roll a 7–11, add 2 to the Attack value of this card.
• If you roll a 12–15, add 3 to the Attack value of this card.
• If you roll a 16–19, add 4 to the Attack value of this card.
• If you roll a 20, add 8 to the Attack value of this card.

powers.name: SHIFTING SANDS
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, choose two small or medium figures on land spaces within 4 clear sight spaces of Arashara Goshiri and within 4 spaces of each other. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, you may switch the two chosen figures. Figures moved by Shifting Sands never take leaving engagement attacks. Arashara Goshiri may be moved by Shifting Sands.

powers.name: STAFF OF LERKINTIN
powers.text: When defending with Arkmer, add as many defense dice as the number of Elves you control adjacent to Arkmer.

powers.name: ENGAGEMENT STRIKE 13
powers.text: If an opponent's small or medium figure moves adjacent to Arkmer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the opponent's figure receives a wound. Figures may only be targeted as they move into engagement with Arkmer.

powers.name: HUNTER ATTACK ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Hunters adjacent to Arktos receive an additional attack die.

powers.name: HUNTER'S AIM SPIRIT
powers.text: When Arktos is destroyed, place this figure on any Unique Army Card with a Range number of 4 or more. Arktos's Spirit adds 2 to the Range number of that card.

powers.name: ULLAR WARLORD BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Armoc Vipers, you may first take a turn with any Warlord you control who follows Ullar.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Armoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: BEAST BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Arrow Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Beast you control.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Arrow Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: PASSING BLOW
powers.text: Once while moving normally, Arthur of Sherwood may choose a small or medium figure that he was not engaged to at the start of this turn. When Arthur leaves engagement with that figure, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the chosen figure receives one wound. Arthur cannot attack the chosen figure on this turn.

powers.name: TREASURE GRAB
powers.text: At any point while moving normally, Arthur of Sherwood may attempt to pick up or activate a Treasure Glyph, as long as he is on a space where he could end his movement. When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with Arthur of Sherwood, if you set off the trap, Arthur ends his movement immediately and may not attempt to pick up or activate that Treasure Glyph again this turn.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Arthur of Sherwood is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: STEALTH UNDERGROUND MOVEMENT
powers.text: Instead of moving normally with Ashi-Dhulu, you may immediately place him on any empty non-water space that is within 4 spaces of Ashi-Dhulu and is no higher than 1 level above his height or 3 levels below his base. If Ashi-Dhulu is engaged when he starts his Stealth Underground Movement, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: DEVOUR FROM BENEATH
powers.text: Before using Stealth Underground Movement, you may choose a small or medium Common figure on a space where Ashi-Dhulu could end his Stealth Underground Movement. Destroy the chosen figure and immediately place Ashi-Dhulu on that space using Stealth Underground Movement.

units.name: Ashigaru Harquebus
units.set: Ashigaru Harquebus Remastered, Fields of Valor: Spearmen and Riflemen

powers.name: WAIT THEN FIRE
powers.text: If none of the Ashigaru Harquebus move this turn, add 1 die to their attack.

units.name: Ashigaru Yari
units.set: Ashigaru Yari Remastered, Fields of Valor: Spearmen and Riflemen

powers.name: ENCIRCLE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 6. If 3 Ashigaru Yari you control are adjacent to the same enemy figure, they may roll their attack dice as one combined attack. The defending figure compares height to the lowest Ashigaru Yari to determine any height advantage. If Encircle Special Attack is used, the 4th figure that moved this turn cannot attack.

powers.name: FOLLOW THE PROFIT
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Associates of Volarak, you may first take a turn with a Profiteer Hero you control. If you do and that Profiteer attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object during that turn, Associates of Volarak add 1 to their Attack Value this Player Turn.

powers.name: PEPPERBOX PISTOL SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 2.
An Associate of Volarak may attack with Pepperbox Pistol Special Attack after making a normal attack.

powers.name: FURIOUS CHARGE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Asterios, you may move Asterios up to 5 spaces. Asterios can attack up to 3 times with Furious Charge Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as Asterios is on a space where he can end his movement. Asterios cannot attack the same figure more than once on a single turn. Asterios will never take any leaving engagement attacks from small or medium Squad figures while using Furious Charge Special Attack.

powers.name: LEGENDARY CREATURE 3
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from small or medium Squad figures, Asterios receives 3 additional defense dice.

powers.name: NECROTIZING WORMHOLE
powers.text: Before moving, you may choose a small or medium figure you control within 5 spaces of Ataraxis. Switch Ataraxis and the chosen figure. If the chosen figure is not Undead, it receives 1 wound. Figures moved by Necrotizing Wormhole never take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: TERROR ENHANCEMENT FIELD
powers.text: Opponents' figures within 5 spaces of Ataraxis roll 1 less defense die against terrifying figures.

powers.name: NANOBOT SOUL CAGE
powers.text: When Ataraxis is destroyed, you may remove all wound markers from this card and place Ataraxis on the card of any Unique Hero within 5 spaces of Ataraxis. For the entire game, if a Unique Hero with your Ataraxis on its card is destroyed by a normal or special attack or a leaving engagement attack, immediately place Ataraxis on a space the destroyed figure occupied, if possible.

units.name: Atlaga the Kyrie Warrior
units.set: Blackmoon's Siege: Heroes of the Moon Tribe

powers.name: KYRIE LEADERSHIP
powers.text: All Kyrie you control, except Atlaga, move one additional space.

powers.name: ULLAR'S BOLT OF THE WITHERWOOD
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Atlaga, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Atlaga. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16 or higher, the chosen figure is destroyed. Atlaga may attempt to use this power only once per game.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Atlaga's movement, ignore elevations. Atlaga may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Atlaga starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: FRENZY
powers.text: After you take a turn with Aubrien Archers, roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may take another turn with Aubrien Archers.

powers.name: RAMMING 6
powers.text: When a small or medium figure rolls defense dice and is not destroyed by a normal or special attack from Augamo, immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or higher, you may Ram the figure. The player who controls the Rammed figure must place that figure, if possible, on an empty space within 2 spaces of its current location, within clear sight of Augamo but not adjacent to him. The space must be on the same level as or lower than its current location. A Rammed figure never takes any leaving engagement attacks. A non-flying figure moved lower by Ramming can receive any falling damage that may apply.

powers.name: HEADLONG CHARGE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 4. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Augamo, you may move Augamo up to 4 spaces. Augamo can attack up to 2 times with Headlong Charge Special Attack at any point before, during or after this move as long as Augamo is on a space where he could end his movement.

powers.name: STONY RESISTANCE 3
powers.text: Augamo rolls 3 additional defense dice when defending against a special attack.

powers.name: WAVE OF FLAME
powers.text: Before moving normally with Avernus, and each time Avernus moves onto a space during normal movement, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Avernus. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Wave of Flame. Avernus cannot roll for Wave of Flame against the same figure more than once per turn.

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANT
powers.text: Avernus never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

powers.name: NEGATIVE ELEMENT
powers.text: Avernus can never roll defense dice while it is on a water space.

powers.name: IMMOLATION 14
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die for Axentia and then once for each figure adjacent to Axentia. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Immolation.

powers.name: PHOENIX RISING
powers.text: When Axentia would be destroyed, do not destroy Axentia. If it is Axentia's turn, her turn ends immediately. Before the next Order Marker is revealed by any player, remove all wound markers from this Army Card and roll the 20-sided die for all figures within 2 clear sight spaces of Axentia, one at a time. If you roll a 7 or higher, the figure receives a wound. After using Phoenix Rising, negate all powers on this card except Flying for the rest of the game.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Axentia's movement, ignore elevations. Axentia may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Axentia starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: REJECTED BY DEATH
powers.text: At the start of each of your turns after Azazel the Kyrie Warrior has been destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 19 or higher, immediately place Azazel on a space adjacent to any figure you control and remove all Wound Markers on Azazel's card.

powers.name: WHIRLWIND ASSAULT
powers.text: Azazel the Kyrie Warrior may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Azazel the Kyrie Warrior's movement, ignore elevations. Azazel may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Azazel starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: FURIOUS WRATH 3
powers.text: When Azurite Warlord attacks, you may add 3 to his Attack number. If you do, at the end of Azurite Warlord's turn place 1 wound marker on Azurite Warlord's Army Card.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Azurite Warlord does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: TO THE LAST MAN
powers.text: Add 1 to the B-11 Resistance Corps' Attack and Defense values for each previously destroyed B-11 Resistance Corps fighter on this Army Card. A B-11 Resistance Corps fighter may not attack other friendly B-11 Resistance Corps fighters.

powers.name: EASY PREY
powers.text: Small Squad figures attacked by Bahadur subtract 2 from their defense dice. Medium Squad figures attacked by Bahadur subtract 1 from their defense dice.

powers.name: WARRIOR'S MELEE ATTACK SPIRIT
powers.text: When Bahadur is destroyed, place this figure on any Unique Army Card with a Range of 1. Bahadur's Spirit adds 1 to the normal Attack number on that card.

powers.name: PIERCING SCREAM
powers.text: After taking a turn with the Banshees of Durgeth Swamp, you may destroy one Common figure within 3 clear sight spaces of at least two Banshees of Durgeth Swamp you control.

powers.name: STEALTH FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for a Banshee of Durgeth Swamp's movement, ignore elevations. A Banshee may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Banshee is engaged when it starts to fly, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: INTELLIGENCE CHIEF
powers.text: The first time each round you reveal a numbered Order Marker on this Army Card, instead of taking a turn with Baroness you may take a turn with up to 2 different COBRA or Agent Heroes you control. Baroness can be one of those heroes.

powers.name: FALSE ORDERS 16
powers.text: At the end of Baroness' turn, you may choose an enemy figure within 6 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may look at an Order Marker on that figure's Army Card. You may then move that Order Marker to the Army Card of another of that player's figures which is within 6 clear sight spaces of Baroness.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Baroness never takes leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Battle Copter
units.set: GI Joe: Greenshirts and Battle Copter

powers.name: STRAFE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Line 5. Attack 3.
Friendly figures are not affected by Strafe Special Attack.

powers.name: BATTLE READY
powers.text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Battle Copter. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

units.name: Beachhead
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: RIGOROUS TRAINING
powers.text: Beachhead adds 1 automatic skull to his attack rolls and 1 automatic shield to his defense rolls.

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: Beachhead does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: SNEAK ATTACK 3
powers.text: If a Beakface Rogue is attacking an opponent's figure that is adjacent to at least one other figure you control, add 3 dice to that Beakface Rogue's attack.

powers.text:

powers.name: G.I. JOE IS THERE

powers.name: ARMORED SUPPORT

powers.name: TANK MOVEMENT

powers.name: ONE TWIN FEELS WHAT THE OTHER TWIN FEELS

powers.name: BANKROLL

powers.name: BUSINESS OPERATIONS
powers.text: After a Crimson Twin attacks with a normal attack, you may move another unengaged COBRA figure you control up to 2 spaces.

units.name: Crimson Widow
units.set: Embers of War: Crimson Widow & Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern

powers.name: HIRE CREW
powers.text: At the start of the game, you may choose a Unique Squad in your Army. For this game the chosen Squad's class becomes Pirate, replacing the class listed on its Army Card.

powers.name: PIRATE COMMANDER
powers.text: While there is an Order Marker on Crimson Widow, all Pirates you control increase their Attack Value by 1 when attacking adjacent figures.

powers.name: MIDNIGHT RAID
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Crimson Widow, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to choose up to two Pirates you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Crimson Widow. You may move the chosen Pirates up to 3 spaces each."

powers.name: ONE SHIELD DEFENSE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice, if Crixus rolls at least one shield, the most wounds Crixus may take for this attack is one.

powers.name: CURSE OF THE MUMMY
powers.text: When you choose an opponent's figure and roll the 20-sided die for a special power on any Undead Army Card, you may add 2 to the die roll if the chosen figure is engaged with this Crypt Guardian.

powers.name: ROYAL ESCORT
powers.text: When Revealing an Order Marker on this Crypt Guardian, after taking this Crypt Guardian's turn, you may take a turn with one other Guard Hero or Queen Hero you control.

powers.name: TOUGH
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, this Crypt Guardian always add one automatic shield to what is rolled.

powers.name: ARROW OF LOVE
powers.text: Start the game with 2 pink Adoration Markers on this Army Card. After moving and before attacking, you may choose an enemy Unique Hero within 5 clear sight spaces and a Unique Hero you control other than Cupid within 3 clear sight spaces of the first figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, place an Adoration Marker on each Hero's Army Card, remove all Order markers on the enemy Hero, and take control of the enemy Hero.

powers.name: LOVESICKNESS
powers.text: After Cupid or a figure with one of your Adoration Markers is destroyed, remove all Order Markers from the controlled Hero. Then, at the end of the round, return it to its original owner and return both Adoration Markers to this Army Card.

powers.name: PSIONIC EXPLOSION SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4. Attack 3.
Choose a figure to attack. Each opponent's figure adjacent to the chosen figure is also affected by the Psionic Explosion Special Attack. Cxurgy'gyath does not need clear line of sight to attack with Psionic Explosion Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: ENSLAVE ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Enslave power on any Army Card.

powers.name: LURK IN SHADOWS
powers.text: If Cxurg'gyath is on a shadow space, opponents' figures must be adjacent to him to attack him with a normal attack.

units.name: Cyprien Esenwein
units.set: Fields of Valor: Heroes of Elswin

powers.name: LIFE DRAIN
powers.text: Each time Cyprien Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Cyprien Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.

powers.name: CHILLING TOUCH
powers.text:
After moving and before attacking, Cyprien Esenwein may attempt a Chilling Touch. To do this, choose a figure adjacent to Cyprien Esenwein and roll the 20-sided die.
• If you roll 1-12, nothing happens.
• If you roll 13-15, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
• If you roll 16-17, the chosen figure receives 2 wounds.
• If you roll 18-19, the chosen figure receives 3 wounds.
• If you roll a 20 or higher, the chosen figure receives 6 wounds.
Cyprien Esenwein's Chilling Touch does not affect Soulborgs or destructible objects.

powers.name: STEALTH FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Cyprien Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Cyprien Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Cyprien Esenwein starts to fly, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: MINDLESS PACK
powers.text:
After revealing an order marker on this card, roll the 20-sided die.
• If you roll a 1-5, you may take a turn with 1 Thrall you control.
• If you roll a 6-15, you may take a turn with up to 2 Thralls you control.
• If you roll a 16 or higher, you may take a turn with up to 3 Thralls you control.

powers.name: POUNCE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 3. Attack 5. Instead of attacking normally, a Darkprowl Thrall may attempt to pounce. To pounce, choose a non-adjacent small or medium figure whose base is not higher or lower than 5 levels from the base of the attacking Thrall. If the figure is destroyed, immediately place the attacking Thrall on the space the figure occupied. If the figure is not destroyed, destroy the attacking Thrall.

powers.name: STEALTHY 4
powers.text: When an unengaged Darkprowl Thrall is attacked with a normal or special attack, add 4 defense dice to the defending Thrall.

powers.name: SNEAK ATTACK 2
powers.text: If Darrak Ambershard is attacking an opponent's figure that is adjacent to at least one other figure you control, add 2 dice to Darrak Ambershard's attack.

powers.name: DISARM TRAPS
powers.text: When you roll the 20-sided die for a Treasure Glyph trap with Darrak Ambershard, you may add 4 to your die roll.

powers.name: HIDE IN DARKNESS
powers.text: If Darrak Ambershard is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If Darrak Ambershard is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If he is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll 1-15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack

powers.name: ULLAR ENHANCED RIFLE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 10. Attack 1. Choose a non‑adjacent small or medium figure to attack. The chosen figure cannot roll defense dice when attacked by Deadeye Dan's Ullar Enhanced Rifle Special Attack. Deadeye Dan may not use this special attack if he moved this turn.

powers.name: SHARPSHOOTER
powers.text: Instead of attacking, you may choose any non‑adjacent figure within 10 clear sight spaces of Deadeye Dan. Roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, the chosen figure is destroyed. If you roll a 1‑18, you missed. Deadeye Dan may not use this special power if he moved this turn.

powers.name: TASKMASTER BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Death Chasers of Thesk, you may first take a turn with any large wild Hero you control.

powers.name: ORC BATTLE RUSH
powers.text: At the start of the first round of the game, after all order markers have been placed, you may move all Death Chasers of Thesk you control up to 5 spaces each. They must end their Orc Battle Rush movement on an empty space.

powers.name: SOUL WEAPONS
powers.text: Figures attacked by a Death Knight of Valkrill subtract 2 from their defense dice. Destructible objects are not affected by Soul Weapons.

powers.name: UNHOLY BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Death Knights of Valkrill, you may first take a turn with any small, medium, or large relentless Hero you control.

powers.name: HEAVY SUPPORT COMMAND BEACON
powers.text: When revealing an order marker on Deathcommander Mark 3's card, after taking his turn, if Deathcommander Mark 3 is engaged, you may immediately take a turn with another Unique or Large Soulborg Hero or Squad you control that follows Utgar.

powers.name: MARKED FOR DESTRUCTION
powers.text: When a Soulborg figure that you control who follows Utgar attacks a figure engaged with Deathcommander Mark 3 with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll one attack die that did not show a skull. Marked for Destruction can only be used once for each attack. Marked for Destruction does not affect Deathcommander Mark 3.

powers.name: EXPLOSIVE ROUNDS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by Explosive Rounds Special Attack. powers.name: SCATTER
powers.text: After a Deathreaver you control rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move any 2 Deathreavers you control up to 4 spaces each.

powers.name: DISENGAGE

powers.name: CLIMB X2
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Deathreavers may double their Height.

powers.name: MAUL

powers.name: PLATING OPTIMIZATION
powers.text: Unique Utgar Soulborgs you control ignore all wounds from special powers that are not special attacks.

powers.name: SELF-DESTRUCT
powers.text: After moving and instead of attacking, Deathwalker may choose to self‑destruct. Roll the 20-sided die to determine if any other figures are wounded. If you roll a 20, each adjacent figure receives 8 wounds. After using this power, Deathwalker is always destroyed.

powers.name: STEALTH DODGE
powers.text: When Deathwalker 7000 rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

powers.name: RAPID FIRE SPECIAL ATTACK

powers.name: EXPLOSION SPECIAL ATTACK

powers.name: RANGE ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: Any Soulborg Guards you control with a Range number of 4 or more that are adjacent to Deathwalker 9000 add 2 spaces to their range.

powers.name: DRILL-DRIVE SPECIAL ATTACK

After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through that turn. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Defending figures never have height advantage against Drill-Drive Special Attack.

powers.name: POISON WEAPONS
powers.text: Each time a Deepwyrm Drow attacks a small, medium, or large Hero with a normal attack or a leaving engagement attack and inflicts at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-11, nothing happens. If you roll a 12 or higher, add 1 additional wound to the defending figure.

powers.name: HIDE IN DARKNESS
powers.text: If a Deepwyrm Drow is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Deepwyrm Drow is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. powers.name: PASSIVE
powers.text: A Deflectatron never makes leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: MAGNETIC DEFLECTOR SHIELD
powers.text: Figures adjacent to one or more Deflectatrons cannot determine clear sight to any figures. powers.name: SLASH AND SHOOT SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range Special. Attack Special. Choose any figure that is engaged with Deltacron to attack and roll 5 attack dice. If Deltacron is not engaged after that attack, you may choose a figure within 4 spaces of Deltacron to attack and roll 3 attack dice.

powers.name: CORRUPTED PROGRAMMING
powers.text: When revealing an order marker on Deltacron, after taking Deltacron's turn, if Deltacron's normal or special attack destroyed a figure or destructible object, you must roll the 20-sided die. units.name: Destro
units.set: GI Joe: Rumble at the Rift

powers.name: GUNRUNNER
powers.text: At the start of the game, you may place up to 2 different Tech Glyphs power-side up onto the Army Cards of up to 2 different Unique Heroes in your Army.

powers.name: BERYLLIUM STEEL MASK
powers.text: Destro adds 1 automatic shield to his defense rolls against attacks from non-adjacent figures.

powers.name: PERSONAL ARSENAL
powers.text: Once per turn, after making a normal attack, Destro may reduce his Attack Value by 2 and make an additional normal attack.

powers.name: MIND EXCHANGE 17

At the end of that turn, control of the chosen Hero returns to the player who controlled the Hero before the Mind Exchange. All Order Markers that were on the chosen Hero's card will stay on the card.

powers.name: FLYING

powers.name: BEND MIND 13

powers.name: ALWAYS PREPARED

powers.name: RALLY THE CREW
powers.text: Start the game with 3 orange Rejuvenation Markers on this card. powers.name: CHARGE!!!

powers.name: CHAIN AXE

units.name: Dr. Harlan Eisen

powers.name: MORE MACHINE THAN VORID
powers.text: Once per game, after removing a Cyaline Marker from this Army Card, you may remove all Wound Markers from this Army Card and return any removed Cyaline Markers to this Army Card. For the remainder of the game add 1 to Dr. Eisen's Attack Value and subtract 1 from his Defense Value.

powers.name: GRAVEROBBER
powers.text: After an enemy figure is destroyed within 5 clear sight spaces of Dr. Torvik Morinstein or another friendly Scientist or Wizard, you may place a chartreuse Parts Marker onto this Army Card, to a maximum of 3.

powers.name: IT'S ALIVE!
powers.text: Once per game, at the end of Dr. Torvik Morinstein's turn, if Morinstein's Masterpiece is in your Army and there are 3 Parts Markers on this Army Card, you may remove them to place your Morinstein's Masterpiece onto the battlefield adjacent to Dr. Morinstein.

powers.name: CHANNEL LIGHTNING SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4 + Special. Attack 2.

units.name: Dr. Valentina Lockhart

powers.name: ORBITAL STRIKE SPECIAL ATTACK

powers.name: WILD STRATEGIC BONDING

powers.name: BERSERKER CHARGE

powers.name: CAPTAIN'S ORDERS
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Dreadnoughts of Caraway Cavern, you may first take a turn with their chosen captain or a Pirate Hero you control.

powers.name: MORTAL BLOW

powers.name: DROW AMBUSH
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on and taking a turn with a Common Drow Army Card, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this card to take a turn with a Drow Assassin you control that has not moved or attacked since the last numbered Order Marker has been revealed. powers.name: SHADOW SHIFT

powers.name: HIDE IN DARKNESS

powers.name: CHAIN GRAB

If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Chain Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: HIDE IN DARKNESS
powers.text: If a Drow Chainfighter is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Drow Chainfighter is on a dungeon space, add 3 to your die roll. If he is on a shadow space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll a 1-15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

units.name: Duke

powers.name: YO, JOE!

powers.name: LEAD BY EXAMPLE

powers.name: ROAD STRENGTH

powers.name: DEVOURER ATTACK ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Devourers adjacent to a Dumutef Guard receive an additional attack die.

powers.name: CRIPPLING GAZE 15
powers.text: Before moving, you may choose a figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Dund. Roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher remove all order markers on the chosen figure's army card (or cards if your opponent has more than one common card for that figure).

powers.name: SAVAGE CRY
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Durgeth Ravagers' Army Card and taking a turn with the Durgeth Ravagers, if the Durgeth Ravagers destroyed at least one opponent's figure this turn, you may immediately take a turn with one Savage Hero you control.

powers.name: HIDE IN SWAMP
powers.text: If a Durgeth Ravager is attacked with a normal attack and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If that Durgeth Ravager is on a swamp space, add 3 to your die roll. If he is on a swamp water space, add 6 to your die roll. If you roll 1-15, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 16 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack.

units.name: Durnipia
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Crooked Crew of the Clockwork Combine

powers.name: SPECIES SPLICER
powers.text: At the start of the game, you may choose 1 Species from another non-Soulborg Army Card in your Army. Until Durnipia is destroyed, she gains that Species.

powers.name: BLOODSTITCHER 15
powers.text: Once per turn, before or after moving normally, Durnipia may choose 1 adjacent non-Soulborg figure and remove 1 or 2 Wound Markers from it. For each roll of 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from Durnipia.

powers.name: I'LL DO IT MYSELF
powers.text: Once per round, before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on an Army Card in your Army, you may move that Order Marker to Durnipia and reveal it.

powers.name: GLACIER TRAVERSE
powers.text: If a Dzu-Teh is adjacent to a Glacier Mountain, the Dzu‑Teh may Glacier Traverse instead of moving normally. You may do this with any or all Dzu‑Teh you control each turn. To Glacier Traverse, move to any unoccupied space adjacent to that Glacier Mountain.

powers.name: GLACIER CAMOUFLAGE

powers.name: SNOW AND ICE ENHANCED MOVEMENT
powers.text: Slippery Ice and Heavy Snow only count as 1 space when moving.

units.name: Earth Elemental
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Fury of the Primordials

powers.name: EARTH SLAM SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. Any non-flying figure adjacent to this Earth Elemental is affected by Earth Slam Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately.

powers.name: UNDERGROUND MOVEMENT

powers.name: DEFENSIVE POSITIONING
