powers.name: ANIMATED MATERIEL
powers.text: When an Ebon Armor you control is destroyed, you may place it on a Unique Human Army Card in your army that does not already have an Ebon Armor on it.

powers.name: ETERNAL WAR
powers.text: For the entire game, when a Unique Human Hero or Squad figure you control is destroyed by a normal or special attack or leaving engagement attack by an opponent's figure, you may replace it with your previously destroyed Ebon Armor from that figure's Army Card, if possible.

powers.name: MOBILE GUNNER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 4.
Eel & F'fuoh may attack with Mobile Gunner Special Attack after attacking normally. You may target and attack non-adjacent figures with Mobile Gunner Special Attack, even while engaged.

powers.name: OUT OF CONTROL
powers.text: If Eel & F'fuoh have 4 or more wounds at the start of their turn, they cannot use Mobile Gunner Special Attack and must attack all adjacent figures, even ones they are not engaged with.

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: Eel & F'fuoh do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: THROUGH THE GREEN
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Eilan Sidhe, all Eilan Sidhe you control adjacent to a tree or bush may use Through the Green. To use Through the Green, place the Eilan Sidhe on any unoccupied space adjacent to any tree or bush within 4 clear sight spaces of that Eilan Sidhe. If an Eilan Sidhe is engaged when it uses Through the Green, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: HORDE ATTACK
powers.text: You may attack with any 2 Eilan Sidhe you control, even Eilan Sidhe that did not move this turn.

powers.name: NATURE'S PROTECTION
powers.text: When an Eilan Sidhe rolls defense dice while adjacent to a tree or bush, one shield will block all damage.

powers.name: SLIPPERY 6
powers.text: If an opponent's Squad figure moves adjacent to Elaria the Pale and onto a space where that Squad figure can end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or higher, Elaria the Pale may immediately move up to 4 spaces. Elaria the Pale will not take any leaving engagement attacks when moving with Slippery. Elaria the Pale can use this power only if she ends her Slippery move not adjacent to any enemy figures. You may not roll for Slippery more than once during any turn.

powers.name: QUEEN OF THIEVES
powers.text: After a tricky figure you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Elaria the Pale rolls the 20-sided die for a special power on its Army Card, you may add 1 to your die roll. Queen of Thieves does not affect Elaria the Pale.

units.name: Eldgrim the Viking Champion
units.set: Dawn of Darkness: Heroes of Durgeth

powers.name: OVEREXTEND ATTACK
powers.text: After taking a turn with Eldgrim, you may place a wound marker on Eldgrim and take another turn with him. You may use this power only once during a round.

powers.name: WARRIOR'S SWIFTNESS SPIRIT
powers.text: When Eldgrim is destroyed, you may place this figure on any unique Army Card. Eldgrim's spirit adds 1 to the move number on that card.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Elite Onyx Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: FRENZY
powers.text: After you take a turn with Elite Onyx Vipers, roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with Elite Onyx Vipers.

powers.name: EVASIVE 8
powers.text: When an Elite Onyx Viper rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, add 8 defense dice to the defending Viper.

units.name: Elites of Ullar
units.set: Gathering Storm: Elites of Ullar and Ranoc Vipers

powers.name: BLADE DANCE
powers.text: Unique Ullar Kyrie you control roll 1 additional die when attacking a figure engaged with 1 or more of your Elites of Ullar.

powers.name: ULLAR'S PACT
powers.text: If an Elite of Ullar receives a wound from a normal attack by an enemy figure, after that attack you may move 1 unengaged Kyrie figure you control who follows Ullar up to 4 spaces, even if all of your Elites of Ullar are destroyed.

powers.name: THUNDER RAM ASSAULT SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1 + Special. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to two other figures within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figures rolls defense dice separately. You can only use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if Eltahale was not adjacent to the targeted figure at the start of this turn. You cannot use Thunder Ram Assault Special Attack if you used Thunder Step this turn.

powers.name: THUNDER STEP
powers.text: Instead of moving Eltahale normally, you may choose an oppnent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Eltahale. Place Eltahale on any empty space adjacent to the chosen figure. For the duration of Eltahale's turn, add 1 to her attack value. At the end of her turn, roll 1 attack die. If a skull is rolled, place 1 wound marker on Eltahale's Army Card. If Eltahale is engaged when she starts Thunder Step, she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ELVEN SUMMONING SPELL
powers.text:
After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add the number of elves you control adjacent to Emirroon to your die roll.
If you roll 1-4, nothing happens.
If you roll 5-11, you may place 1 Elf you control adjacent to Emirroon.
If you roll 12-17, you may place up to 2 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon.
If you roll 18-20, you may place up to 3 Elves you control adjacent to Emirroon.
If the summoning Elves are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Emirroon cannot summon an Elf that he is already adjacent to.

powers.name: ORB OF VENGEANCE AURA
powers.text: When a figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Emperor Andask attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Orb of Vengeance Aura does not affect Emperor Andask. Orb of Vengeance Aura may only be used once per turn.

powers.name: KYRIE SUPREMACY
powers.text: Any time you roll the 20-sided die for a Kyrie army card, you may add 1 to your die roll.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Emperor Andask's movement, ignore elevations. Emperor Andask may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Emperor Andask is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Empress Kiova
units.set: Dawn of Darkness: Heroes of Durgeth

powers.name: GIFT OF THE EMPRESS AURA
powers.text: When you roll defense dice for any Kyrie you control who follows Einar and is within 5 clear sight spaces of Empress Kiova, you may re-roll all defense dice that did not show shields. Gift of the Empress Aura can be used only once for each defense roll. Empress Kiova's Gift of the Empress Aura does not affect Empress Kiova.

powers.name: STEALTH FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Empress Kiova's movement, ignore elevations. Empress Kiova may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Empress Kiova starts to fly, if she is engaged she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: FIRE BLAST SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack Special. Each time you attack with Erevan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack, you may choose to roll 2, 3, or 4 attack dice. If a skull is rolled on every die, you may attack again with Everan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack. You may continue attacking with Everan Sunshadow's Fire Blast Special Attack until you do not roll a skull on every die.

powers.name: FEY STEP
powers.text: Once per game, Erevan Sunshadow may use Fey Step. Before moving normally with Erevan Sunshadow, you may place him on any empty space within 5 spaces of his current location. If Erevan Sunshadow is engaged when he uses Fey Step, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Estivara
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerun

powers.name: VENOM RAY SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. If Estivara inflicts at least 1 wound with Venom Ray Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die for Venom Damage. If you roll a 1-9, the defending figure receives no additional wounds for Venom Damage. If you roll a 10-19, add 1 additional wound marker to the defending figure's Army Card, and roll again for Venom Damage. If you roll a 20, destroy the defending figure.

powers.name: LOLTH'S JUDGEMENT AURA
powers.text: All Arachnid figures you control within 6 clear sight spaces of Estivara roll 1 additional attack die when attacking normally.

powers.name: CLOUD OF DARKNESS
powers.text: After taking a turn with Estivara, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, while she remains on that space, Estivara has no visible Hit Zone until the next time you reveal an order marker.

powers.name: DOUBLE ASSAULT
powers.text: When Evar Scarcarver attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: FROST RAGE
powers.text: When revealing a numbered order marker on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card, you may also reveal an "X" order marker that is on Evar Scarcarver's Army Card to activate Frost Rage for the duration of the round. While Frost Rage is active, add 1 to Evar Scarcarver's Attack and Defense values for each wound marker on his Army Card.

powers.name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Ewashia, Master of Tides, before taking Ewashia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

powers.name: TWISTER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 6. Attack 4.
Ewashia may use Twister Special Attack if she is within 1 space of a water tile. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose up to 2 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. All figures on those spaces are also affected by Twister Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Ewashia is not affected by Twister Special Attack.

powers.name: AEGIS OF THE RIVER
powers.text: Ewashia does not have to stop her movement when entering a water space. Add 1 to Ewashia's Defense Value while she is on a water space.

powers.name: CREATE WATER
powers.text: Ewashia starts each game with 3 water tiles on this Army Card. At the end of Ewashia's turn, you may place a water tile from this Army Card on Ewashia's space or within 1 space of Ewashia, if the water tile fits normally onto that space.

powers.name: DEADLY STRIKE
powers.text: When attacking with Executioner 616, each skull rolled counts as one additional hit.

powers.name: REMOTE DETONATION
powers.text: Instead of attacking, you may choose Executioner 616 or another Soulborg you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Executioner 616. Roll the 20-sided die. Add 3 to your die roll if the chosen figure is medium, 7 to your die roll if the chosen figure is large, and 10 to your die roll if the chosen figure is huge. If you roll 1-12, nothing happens. If you roll 13-19, all figures adjacent to the chosen figure receive one wound. If you roll a 20 or higher, all figures adjacent to the chosen figure receive 3 wounds. After using Remote Detonation, destroy the chosen figure.

powers.name: BLACK POWDER PISTOLS
powers.text: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to the Exiles of the Sundered Sea's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.

powers.name: STEALTHY 13
powers.text: If an Exile of the Sundered Sea you control is attacked by an opponent's figure that is not adjacent and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-12, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 13 or higher, that Exile takes no damage and may immediately move up to 3 spaces.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Exiles of the Sundered Sea are never attacked when leaving an engagment.

powers.name: STAFF OF ENFEEBLEMENT
powers.text: Start the game with one Enfeeblement Marker on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may place your Enfeeblement Marker on the Army Card of a Unique Hero within 4 clear sight spaces of Father Caylus. For the remainder of the round, that Unique Hero subtracts 1 from its Move and Attack values and cannot attack with any special attack. At the end of the round, return your Enfeeblement Marker to this card.

powers.name: BRUTAL TASKMASTER
powers.text: If there is a revealed Order Marker on Father Caylus, all Clerics you control that start their turn within 4 clear sight spaces of Father Caylus may add 2 to their Move value and add 1 to their Attack value. This power does not affect Father Caylus.

units.name: Fen Hydra
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Warriors of the Ghostlight Fen

powers.name: HYDRA HEADS
powers.text: When this Fen Hydra attacks, it may attack up to 4 times. Reduce the number of times this Fen Hydra can attack by 1 for each wound marker on this Army Card.

powers.name: REACH
powers.text: If an opponent's figure is within 2 spaces of this Fen Hydra, and its base is no more than 3 levels above this Fen Hydra's height or 3 levels below this Fen Hydra's base, this Fen Hydra may add 1 to its Range when attacking that figure.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: The Fen Hydra does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: BLOOD FRENZY
powers.text: When attacking with this Feral Troll, it receives 1 extra attack die for each wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card, to a maximum of 3 additional attack dice for Blood Frenzy.

powers.name: REGENERATE
powers.text: After taking a turn with this Feral Troll, remove 1 Wound Marker from this Feral Troll's Army Card.

units.name: Festering Honor Guard
units.set: Rising Tide: Queen Maladrix & Festering Honor Guard

powers.name: PARASITE
powers.text: For the entire game, if one of your Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card at the end of the round, you must roll the 20-sided die for that Hero. If you roll a 17 or higher, destroy that Hero. If a Festering Honor Guard is on a Unique Hero's Army Card when that Hero is destroyed by this Special Power, or by a normal attack, Special Attack, or leaving engagement attack, place that Festering Honor Guard on a space that Hero occupied, if possible.

powers.name: MOTHERLESS RAGE
powers.text: If Queen Maladrix the Conqueror is in your Army, when she is destroyed, you may move any unrevealed Order Markers from her Army Card to this Army Card. Festering Honor Guard add 1 to their Attack Value if Queen Maladrix is in your Army and is destroyed.

powers.name: CLIMB X2
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, the Festering Honor Guard may double their Height.

powers.name: BLACK POWDER PISTOL
powers.text: Start the game with 3 black Powder Markers on this card. After moving and before attacking, you may remove a Powder Marker from this card to add 4 to Fia Bonny the Void Siren's Range Value for the rest of the turn. You may only use this Special Power once during a round.

powers.name: MASTER OF DISGUISE 13
powers.text: The first time each turn that Fia Bonny is targeted by a Squad figure with a normal or special attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Fia Bonny cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attack this turn.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Fia Bonny is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: ATTACK AURA 1
powers.text: All friendly figures adjacent to Finn with a range of 1 add 1 die to their normal attack.

powers.name: WARRIOR'S ATTACK SPIRIT 1
powers.text: When Finn is destroyed, place this figure on any unique Army Card. Finn's Spirit adds 1 to the normal attack number on that card.

units.name: Fire Elemental
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Fury of the Primordials

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANT
powers.text: A Fire Elemental never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

powers.name: SEARING INTENSITY
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to at least one Fire Elemental you control. If you roll a 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant special power are not affected by Searing Intensity.

powers.name: NEGATIVE ELEMENT
powers.text: A Fire Element can never roll defense dice while it is on a water space.

units.name: Firefly
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: DRONE-DEPLOYED BOMBS
powers.text: Start the game with 4 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may place a Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from this Army card power-side up onto a space within 6 spaces of Firefly.

powers.name: DETONATE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 4.
Choose 1 Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph on the battlefield. All figures within 1 space of the chosen Glyph are affected, regardless of engagement and line of sight. Roll once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures do not have height advantage against this attack. After this attack is resolved, remove the chosen Remote Bomb Treasure Glyph from the game.

powers.name: DIFUSE 10
powers.text: Firefly may add 10 to his 20-sided die rolls for Traps and to pick up Treasure Glyphs.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Firefly can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Flint
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: GLIDE IN 11
powers.text: Flint does not start the game on the battlefield. If Flint has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, place Flint on an empty space. You cannot place Flint adjacent to other figures or on Glyphs. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order markers to this Army Card.

powers.name: TACTICAL ACUMEN
powers.text: When Flint or a G.I. JOE or Soldier figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Flint defends, it increases its Defense Value by 1 if Flint has height advantage on the attacking figure.

units.name: Frizzt Galagan
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Paragons of the New Alliance

powers.name: FIRE WHEN READY
powers.text: At the end of your Player Turn, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take a turn with Frizzt Galagan. No other Army Card may take this turn instead of Frizzt. If Frizzt moves during this turn, he cannot attack.

powers.name: RA-1A GUIDED CANNON SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 10. Attack 2.
RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack can target only figures that are adjacent to one or more figures you control. Figures never have height advantage against RA-1A Guided Cannon Special Attack

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: Frizzt does not have to stop his movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: INDOMITABLE
powers.text: If this Frost Giant of Morh begins its turn unengaged, add 2 to its Move value this turn. If it begins its turn engaged, add 2 to its Attack value this turn.

powers.name: BATTLE FRENZY
powers.text: After attacking with this Frost Giant of Morh, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, you may attack again with this Frost Giant of Morh.

powers.name: DYING SWIPE
powers.text: If this Frost Giant of Morh is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives enough wounds to be destroyed, roll 3 attack dice. One at a time for each skull rolled, you may inflict 1 wound on any figure that is adjacent to this Frost Giant of Morh. Figures affected by Dying Swipe cannot roll any defense dice and can receive more than 1 wound each. After using Dying Swipe, remove this Frost Giant of Morh from the battlefield.

powers.name: RUN 3
powers.text: Before moving a Frostclaw Paladin, you may add 3 to that figure's Move Value this turn. If you do, subtract 2 from that figure's Attack Value this turn.

powers.name: JANDAR CHAMPION BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Frostclaw Paladins, you may take a turn with a Champion you control who follows Jandar.

units.name: Fyorlag Spiders
units.set: Ticalla Jungle / Grove at Laur's Edge

powers.name: CLIMB X3
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Fyorlag Spiders may triple their height.

powers.name: ENTANGLING WEB
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any one small or medium opponent's figure that is engaged with at least three Fyorlag Spiders that you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove one unrevealed order marker at random from the chosen figure's Army Card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure).

powers.name: PREDATOR BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Fyorlag Spiders, you may first take a turn with any Predator you control.

powers.name: FIGHT THE LAW
powers.text: When attacking a Lawman, Garrett Burns rolls 1 additional attack die.

powers.name: QUICK DRAW 13
powers.text: When Garrett Burns is targeted for a normal attack from an opponent's non-adjacent figure within 7 clear sight spaces of Garrett Burns, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound.

units.name: Gelryie Vanguards
units.set: Embers of War: Krakenling & Gelryie Vanguards

powers.name: TIDAL ADVANCE
powers.text: At the start of each round, after placing Order Markers, you may move each Fierce and Unfathomable figure you control up to 1 space for each of your Order Markers on the Gelryie Vanguards.

powers.name: DEFEND THE DEEP
powers.text: A Gelryie Vanguard adds 2 to its Defence Value when it is on a water space or when it defends against an attack from a figure that has height advantage.

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: Gelryie Vanguards do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: COMBAT LEADER
powers.text: If at least one Order Marker is on Gen. Simon Fraser, you may add 3 to your initiative roll.

powers.name: PREPARE THE CHARGE
powers.text: All friendly Soldiers who start their turn within 6 clear sight spaces of Gen. Simon Fraser may add 2 to their Move number as long as they are unengaged prior to moving. Figures must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Prepare the Charge.

units.name: Gimbal
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Clockwork Combine Research Expedition

powers.name: DRACONIC ENGINEERING
powers.text: Gimbal starts each game with the B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S., and C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card. These Treasure Glyphs cannot be placed on this Army Card except by this power. Gimbal cannot drop these glyphs except when destroyed or with the Ablative Equipment Special Power.

powers.name: ABLATIVE EQUIPMENT
powers.text: When Gimbal would take 1 or more wounds, you may place a B.R.E.A.T.H., W.I.N.G.S., or C.L.A.W.S. Treasure Glyph on this Army Card onto an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Gimbal. If you do, ignore all wounds.

units.name: Girushia, Grove Keeper
units.set: Embers of War: Heroes of Arboreas

powers.name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Girushia, Grove Keeper, before taking Girushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

powers.name: WICKED THORNS
powers.text: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves adjacent to Girushia on a space where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 10 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also suffers one wound.

powers.name: REACH
powers.text: If an opponent's figure is within 2 spaces of Girushia, and its level is no more than 9 levels above or 3 levels below Girushia's level, Girushia may add 1 to his Range when attacking that figure.

powers.name: GIFT OF THE FOREST
powers.text: At the end of a round, if Girushia is next to a tree or bush, you may remove one Wound Marker from this army card.

powers.name: CYBERCLAW
powers.text: All small or medium opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to any Gladiatron may not move. Figures affected by the Cyberclaw cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.

powers.name: MELEE DEFENSE 1
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Gladiatron adds 1 die.

powers.name: HANWI'S DARKNESS
powers.text: When you reveal an Order Marker, you may also reveal the "X" Order Marker on Glinerva the Kyrie Warrior to activate Hanwi's Darkness. Until you next reveal an Order Marker, Glinerva and all Small, Medium, and Large figures within 5 spaces of her cannot target or be targeted by non-adjacent figures with a normal or special attack.

powers.name: CONCEALMENT 17
powers.text: If Glinerva is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and Glinerva. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore any wounds Glinerva just received.

units.name: Gnarlfur Raiders
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Might of the New Alliance

powers.name: MIGHTY HERO BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Gnarlfur Raiders, you may first take a turn with a Valiant or Relentless Hero you control whose Affiliation is Utgar or Jandar.

powers.name: BROTHERS IN BLOOD
powers.text: Increase the Move, Attack, and Defense Values of this Army Card by 1 for each of your destroyed Gnarlfur Raiders.

units.name: Goblin Cutters
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Ogre and Goblins

powers.name: MOB ATTACK
powers.text: When attacking with a Goblin Cutter you control, if the defending figure is engaged with at least 2 other Goblin Cutters you control, it subtracts 2 from its defense dice.

powers.name: SCURRY
powers.text: When a Goblin Cutter you control is destroyed by a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move any 2 Goblin Cutters you control up to 4 spaces each, and all Goblin Cutters you control no longer have any visible Hit Zones for the duration of the attacking figure's turn while they remain unengaged. Goblin Cutters will never take any leaving engagement attacks while using Scurry.

powers.name: SCALE
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Goblin Cutters may add 2 to their height.

powers.name: GOBLIN RETREAT
powers.text: After attacking with Goblin Slashers, you may move 3 engaged Goblin Slashers you control up to 3 spaces each. A Goblin Slasher never takes leaving engagement attacks when moving with Goblin Retreat and can only move if it ends its retreating move not adjacent to any enemy figures.

powers.name: YOU GOT THIS, BOSS!
powers.text: After taking a turn with the Goblin Slashers, if no Goblin Slashers you control are engaged, you may take a turn with a Goblin Hero you control.

powers.name: SCALE
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Goblin Slashers may add 2 to their height.

powers.name: TOUGH
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Gorillinators always add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: PRIMADON STRATEGIC ATTACK BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Gorillitroopers, you may first take a turn with any Primadon Hero you control. That Primadon Hero may only attack during its turn. If you take a turn with any Primadon Hero you control, the Gorillitroopers cannot use their Autocannons special power this turn.

powers.name: AUTOCANNONS
powers.text: Before attacking, you may add 4 to the Range number and subtract 2 from the Attack number of this Army Card for the duration of this turn. When using Autocannons, a Gorillitrooper that did not move this turn may attack one additional time.

powers.name: TOUGH
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Gorillitroopers always add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: VALKRILL CHARGE
powers.text: If Gothlok begins his turn unengaged, after moving and before attacking you may roll 12 Valkrill Valkyrie Dice. For each Valkrill symbol rolled, add 1 to Gothlok's attack this turn.

powers.name: AURA OF DESPAIR
powers.text: All figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Gothlok roll 1 less defense die. Figures that follow Valkrill are not affected by Aura of Despair.

powers.name: ROCK THROW
powers.text: If a Granite Guardian has a height advantage on an opponent's figure, it may add 2 to its range when attacking that figure.

powers.name: LANDSLIDE
powers.text: A Granite Guardian with a height advantage on an adjacent opponent's figure rolls an additional attack die when attacking that figure.

powers.name: GAIN HIGH GROUND
powers.text: After taking a turn with Granite Guardians, you may move each Granite Guardian you control up to 1 space. This space may be up to 4 levels higher.

units.name: Grave Grim
units.set: Boiling Tensions: Revnan Acolytes & Grave Grim

powers.name: GUIDE OF THE DEAD
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with a Grave Grim, you may move up to 6 Small, Medium, or Large Undead or Eisenek figures you control up to 3 spaces each.

powers.name: HARROWING PRESENCE
powers.text: When an opponent rolls the 20-sided die for a Special Power on one of their Army Cards, if one or more of that Army Card's figures are within 3 spaces of a figure you control with the Harrowing Presence special power, they must subtract 3 from the roll.

units.name: Greatbow Archers
units.set: Embers of War: Greatbow Archers & Scions of Icaria

powers.name: LONGSHOT SPECIALISTS
powers.text: When a Greatbow Archer that has not moved this turn attacks a figure at Range 4 or greater, add 1 to her Attack Value. If the target is at Range 7 or greater, instead add 2 to her Attack Value.

units.name: Greater Ice Elemental
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Glaun Bog Raiders

powers.name: ICE COLD
powers.text: While a Greater Ice Elemental is on a water or ice space, that space and all same-level water spaces adjacent to that Greater Ice Elemental are considered normal ice spaces. Figures do not have to stop their movement on normal ice spaces.

powers.name: ICE SPIKES 15
powers.text: If an opponent's figure moves adjacent to this Greater Ice Elemental, roll the 20-sided die. If this Greater Ice Elemental is on at least one ice or snow space, add 2 to your die roll. If you roll a 15 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound. Figures can be affected by Ice Spikes only as they move into engagement with this Greater Ice Elemental.

powers.name: COLD HEALING
powers.text: After taking a turn with this Greater Ice Elemental, if it is on at least one snow or ice space, remove 1 wound marker from this Greater Ice Elemental's Army Card.

units.name: Greenscale Warriors
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Glaun Bog Raiders

powers.name: LOYALTY TO THE LIZARD KING
powers.text: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Lizardfolk Hero you control, or a Unique large or huge Dragon Hero you control, to be the Greenscale Warriors' Lizard King. A Greenscale Warrior rolls 1 additional attack and defense die when its chosen Lizard King is within 2 clear sight spaces. You can choose only one Lizard King for all the Greenscale Warriors you control.

powers.name: LIZARD KING BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Greenscale Warriors, you may first take a turn with their chosen Lizard King if it is still under your control.

units.name: Greenshirts
units.set: GI Joe: Greenshirts and Battle Copter

powers.name: WHEREVER THERE'S TROUBLE
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Greenshirts, you may move up to 2 unengaged G.I. JOE or Soldier Heroes you control up to 2 spaces.

powers.name: SPLIT DECISION
powers.text: At the start of Grigor & Rogirg's turn, if there are 3 or fewer wound markers on this Army Card, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 6 or lower, Grigor & Rogirg cannot attack if they move this turn.

powers.name: TWO HEADS ARE BETTER THAN ONE
powers.text: After attacking with Grigor & Rogirg, if there are 3 or fewer wound markers on this Army Card, they may attack one additional time.

powers.name: CHOMP
powers.text: Before attacking, choose one medium or small figure adjacent to Grimnak. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure, destroy it. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure, roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, destroy the chosen Hero.

powers.name: ORC WARRIOR ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Grimnak roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

powers.name: MARRO WARLORD BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Grok Riders, you may first take a turn with any Marro Warlord you control.

powers.name: MARK OF THE WARLORD
powers.text: When attacking a figure that is adjacent to any Marro Warlord you control, Grok Riders add 2 to their attack dice.

powers.name: GROK TRAINING
powers.text: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Grok Riders with its Marro Rebirth special power.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Guilty McCreech attacks, he may attack one additional time.

units.name: Guilty McCreech (2.0)
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Crooked Crew of the Clockwork Combine

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: Once per turn, after attacking with Guilty McCreech, he may make 1 additional normal attack.

powers.name: DEPUTIZE
powers.text: At the start of the game, you may place a silver Badge Marker on 1 Unique Hero in your Army that is a Sniper or follows Einar or Volarak. For this game, it gains the Class of Lawman.

powers.name: LONG ARM OF THE LAW
powers.text: Once per turn, before, during, or after moving normally, you may choose a Treasure Glyph within 3 clear sight spaces and place that Glyph power-side up on Guilty's Army Card or the Army Card of a friendly Unique Lawman Hero within 3 clear sight spaces of Guilty. Do not roll for traps on Treasure Glyphs collected with Long Arm of the Law.

units.name: Gung-Ho
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: EXPEDITION LEADER
powers.text: Gung-Ho and friendly figures within 2 clear sight spaces may choose to ignore any effects from terrain tiles they move onto or occupy other than molten lava.

powers.name: COMBAT CHALLENGE
powers.text: Figures engaged with Gung-Ho cannot make an attack unless that attack affects an engaged figure with the Combat Challenge special power.

powers.name: NO FEAR, ALL FIGHT
powers.text: Gung-Ho increases his Attack and Defense Values by 1 for each figure he is engaged with.

powers.name: EVIL EYE DEFENSE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure.

powers.name: TETSUBO SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one figure adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by the Tetsubo Special Attack as well. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: DOUBLE DIABLO GUN
powers.text: This figure can target non-adjacent figures even while engaged. Once per turn, after attacking with this figure, it may make one additional normal attack.

powers.name: BATTLE READY
powers.text: Before you reveal a numbered Order Marker on another Army Card in your Army, you may reveal the "X" Ordre Marker on H.I.S.S. Tank. If you do, move that numbered Order Marker to this Army Card and reveal it.

powers.name: TANK MOVEMENT
powers.text: When moving, this figure ignores elevation changes of only 1 level.

powers.name: AEGIS OF THE CRIMSON SIGIL
powers.text: When Haduc, or any Elf Wizard you control adjacent to Haduc, rolls defense dice, add one automatic shield to whatever is rolled for each revealed order marker on Haduc's Army Card.

powers.name: ELVEN SUPREMACY
powers.text: Any time you roll the 20-sided die for an Elf Army Card, you may add 1 to your die roll.

units.name: Haluchott, Corruptor of Beasts
units.set: Embers of War: Heroes of Arboreas

powers.name: COMMAND OF THE WILD
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Haluchott, Corruptor of Beasts, before taking Haluchott's turn, you may take a turn with up to two Small, Medium, or Large Beasts you control.

powers.name: STAFF OF THE LONG HAND SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 6. Attack 2. You may use the Staff of the Long Hand Special Attack before or after using Haluchott's normal attack.

powers.name: CALM THE BEAST
powers.text: While defending against an attack from a Beast, Haluchott increases her Defense Value by 2.

units.name: Halushia, Scion of the Wild
units.set: Rising Tide: Sonlen & Halushia, Scion of the Wild

powers.name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Halushia, Scion of the Wild, before taking Halushia's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

powers.name: ROUSE THE GLADE
powers.text: Figures adjacent to a tree or bush roll one fewer Combat Die when defending against Halushia's attacks.

powers.name: RIDE-BY SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Halushia, you may move him up to 4 spaces. Halushia can attack up to 3 times with Ride-By Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as he is on a space where he can end his movement. Halushia cannot attack the same figure more than once in a single turn with Ride-By Special Attack. When using Ride-By Special Attack, Halushia is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

units.name: Hands of Hrungnir
units.set: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

powers.name: TOSS 11
powers.text: After moving normally with a Hand of Hrungnir, you may choose a Small or Medium figure adjacent to that Hand. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may place that figure on any empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of that Hand. A figure moved by Toss does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: DEATHCLAP SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Line Special. Attack 5.
If your Hands are in a straight line and there are no more than 6 spaces between them, instead of making a normal attack with each Hand, choose 1 Hand to use Deathclap Special Attack. All figures in a straight line between both Hands are affected by Deathclap Special Attack.

units.name: Hatamoto Taro (1.0)
units.set: Crest of the Valkyrie, Einar High Command Remastered

powers.name: HEROIC DEFENSE AURA
powers.text: When defending against a normal attack by an adjacent figure with any Samurai or Ashigaru figures you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. powers.name: ADJACENT TOUGH 1
powers.text: When rolling defense dice for Hatamoto Taro, if Hatamoto Taro is adjacent to at least one figure you control who follows Einar, add one automatic shield to the defense roll.

powers.name: STALWART DEFENSE AURA
powers.text: When another Einar figure you control within 8 clear sight spaces of Hatamoto Taro defends, you may roll Einar Valkyrie dice. Once per Player Turn after rolling defense dice, you may choose to count each Einar symbol rolled as an additional shield.

powers.name: ADJACENT EINAR RESOLVE 1
powers.text: When Hatamoto Taro defends, if he is adjacent to at least 1 Einar figure you control, add 1 automatic shield to the roll.

powers.name: PLASMA SURGE
powers.text: After attacking a non-adjacent figure with a Havech Eradicator you control, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-6, destroy that Havech Eradicator. If you roll a 7-17, that Havech Eradicator is safe. If you roll an 18-20, you may attack again with that Havech Eradicator.

powers.name: MECHANICAL COMPONENTS
powers.text: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Havech Eradicators with its Marro Rebirth special power.

units.name: Head of Hrungnir
units.set: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

powers.name: UNITED BODY
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with Head of Hrungnir, you may first take a turn with 2 other different Relic Army Cards you control. Any figures activated by United Body must be within 7 spaces of Head of Hrungnir to be activated.

powers.name: GIANT EVIL EYE
powers.text: When Head of Hrungnir or a Relic figure you control within 7 spaces successfully defends against a normal attack from a figure that is within clear sight of Head of Hrungnir and is not adjacent to a Relic you control, the attacking figure takes 1 wound for each excess shield.

powers.name: GUARDS! GUARDS!
powers.text: During an enemy unit’s turn, the first time an enemy figure moves at least one space and ends its normal movement within 4 clear sight spaces of Head Warden Lermek, you may immediately move up to 4 Guards you control up to 4 spaces. Guards must be able to move adjacent to Lermek or an opponent’s figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Lermek in order to use Guards! Guards!

powers.name: ESOTERIC TRAINING 8
powers.text: When Head Warden Lermek would receive one or more wounds from a special attack or a special power on any Army Card or glyph, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 8 or higher, ignore those wounds.

powers.name: WARDEN'S DISCIPLINE
powers.text: Wardens and Guards you control cannot be moved by any special power on any opponent’s Army Card.

units.name: Heart of Hrungnir
units.set: Awakened Ancient of the Umbral Covenant

powers.name: THUNDEROUS HEARRTBEAT SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 2.
Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack affects all enemy figures within 7 spaces that are adjacent to Relics you control, regardless of line of sight. Roll attack dice once. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Figures never have height advantage against Thunderous Heartbeat Special Attack.

powers.name: BOUND BY THE OLD MAGIC
powers.text: When another Relic figure you control within 7 spaces would take 1 or more wounds, you may ignore those wounds. If you do, the Heart of Hrungnir takes an equal number of wounds.

units.name: Heavy Gruts
units.set: Dawn of Darkness: Shades and Orcs

powers.name: ORC CHAMPION BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Heavy Gruts, you may first take a turn with any Orc Champion you control.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Heavy Gruts are never attacked when leaving engagements.

units.name: Heirloom
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Heroes of Khorvaire

powers.name: FORCE ORB SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose an opponent's figure to attack. Each opponent's figure adjacent to the chosen figure is also affected by Force Orb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: MAGE HAND
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Heirloom, you may choose a Treasure Glyph on an unoccupied space within 4 spaces of Heirloom. You may move that Treasure Glyph onto any empty same-level space adjacent to Heirloom. Symbol-side-up Treasure Glyphs cannot be revealed, and a power-side-up Treasure Glyph must be placed power-side-up when moved by Mage Hand.

powers.name: WARFORGED RESOLVE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Heirloom always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: BLAST FURNACE 15
powers.text: During Hellforge Mandukor's turn, before moving with it and each time it moves onto a space during this movement, you must roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to Hellforge. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant Special Power are not affected by Blast Furnace. Hellforge cannot roll for Blast Furnace against the same figure more than once per turn.

powers.name: FEED THE FORGE 15
powers.text: If a figure or destructible object adjacent to Hellforge is destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. Add 8 to the roll if the figure is an Eisenek, Soulborg, or destructible object. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove a Wound Marker from this card.

powers.name: EISENEK ADVANCE
powers.text: At the start of each round after all Order Markers have been placed, if all your Order Markers are placed on Eisenek Army Cards, you may move Hellforge up to 4 spaces. Hellforge must end this movement on an empty space.

powers.name: LABORS
powers.text: After taking a turn with Heracles, you may reveal an "X" Order Marker that is on Heracles's Army Card and take another turn with Heracles. During this additional turn, Heracles cannot attack a small or medium figure.

powers.name: FEARLESS ADVANTAGE
powers.text: Heracles rolls an additional die when attacking or defending against large or huge figures.

powers.name: THROW 14
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, choose one small or medium non-flying figure adjacent to Heracles. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may place the figure on any empty space within 4 clear sight spaces of Heracles. If the figure was placed on a non-water space on a level equal to or lower than Heracles's height, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the thrown figure receives 2 wounds. The thrown figure does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ONSLAUGHT 3
powers.text: After attacking with Himmelskralle, if she destroyed a figure with her normal attack, Himmelskralle may move up to 3 spaces and attack again. Himmelskralle may continue using Onslaught until she does not destroy a figure.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Himmelskralle's movement, ignore elevations. Himmelskralle may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Himmelskralle starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Honor Guard of the Blasted Lands

powers.name: ARC LANCES
powers.text: All Honor Guards you control adjacent to at least one other Honor Guard you control receive 1 automatic skull when attacking.

powers.name: PROTECTIVE REPOSITIONING
powers.text: At the end of each round, you may move up to 6 Honor Guard figures you control up to 2 spaces each. Honor Guards must be able to move adjacent to a friendly figure to use Protective Repositioning.

powers.name: SHIELD PUSH 13
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with a Hoplitron, you may choose one small or medium figure adjacent to that Hoplitron. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, move the chosen figure up to 1 space. Figures moved by Shield Push never take any leaving engagement attacks. A non-flying figure moved lower by Shield Push can receive any falling damage that may apply.

powers.name: MELEE SOULBORG BONDING
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on a Hoplitron Army Card, before taking that Hoplitron's turn, you may take a turn with one other Soulborg Hero you control with a Range of 1.

powers.name: EXPENDABLE RABBLE
powers.text: If a Horned Skull Brute you control is attacked with a normal attack by an opponent's figure and receives 1 or more wounds, you may destroy a small Goblin figure you control that is adjacent to that Horned Skull Brute to ignore any wounds that Horned Skull Brute just received.

powers.name: BARGE INTO BATTLE
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, if a Horned Skull Brute you control ends its movement unengaged, you may choose an engaged small or medium friendly Squad figure within 3 clear sight spaces of that Horned Skull Brute whose base is no more that 2 levels higher or lower than the base of that Horned Skull Brute. You may switch that Horned Skull Brute with the chosen Squad figure. Figures moved by Barge into Battle never take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ORC MOVEMENT AURA
powers.text: If an Orc figure you control begins its turn within 2 clear sight spaces of Hrognak, it may move 1 additional space. Hrognak's Orc Movement Aura does not affect Hrognak.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Hrognak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: ORC MOVEMENT AURA
powers.text: If an Orc figure you control begins its turn within 2 clear sight spaces of Hrognak, it may move 1 additional space. Hrognak's Orc Movement Aura does not affect Hrognak.

powers.name: TRIHORN CHARGE 3
powers.text: Hrognak rolls 3 additional attack dice when attacking any figure that was at least 3 clear sight spaces away from Hrognak at the start of his turn.

powers.name: HOWDAH ARCHER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 6. Attack 2. After attacking normally, Hrognak may attack with Howdah Archer Special Attack. Hrognak may target and attack non-adjacent figures with Howdah Archer Special Attack while engaged.

powers.name: ICE TROLL CHARGE
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with this Ice Troll Berserker, roll the 20-sided die. If this Ice Troll Berserker is on a snow or ice space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may move this Ice Troll Berserker again.

powers.name: COLD REGENERATE
powers.text: After taking a turn with this Ice Troll Berserker, remove 1 wound marker from this Ice Troll Berserker's Army Card. If it is on a snow or ice space, remove 1 additional wound marker.

powers.name: STOMP 8
powers.text: Once during Imperator Kayne's turn, at any point during his normal movement that he is on a space where he could end his movement, you may choose an adjacent Small or Medium figure whose level is no more than 5 levels above Kayne's level and roll the 20-sided die: If you roll 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.

powers.name: RAGE SMASH 5
powers.text: When Incredible Hulk attacks using a normal attack, he receives one extra attack die for each Wound Marker he has, up to a maximum of 5 extra attack dice for Rage Smash.

powers.name: SUPER LEAP
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Incredible Hulk may Super Leap. Super Leap has a move of 10. When counting spaces for Hulk's Super Leap movement, ignore elevations. Hulk may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Hulk may not leap more than 50 levels up or down in a single leap. If Hulk is engaged when he starts to leap, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. Hulk rolls 3 less attack dice on any turn that he chooses to Super Leap.

powers.name: STOMP SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 1. Attack 3.
Any figure adjacent to Incredible Hulk is affected by the Stomp Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense separately. Hulk cannot attack using his Stomp Special Attack on the same turn he uses Super Leap.

units.name: Iron Golem
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Golem and Wyrmlings

powers.name: IRON TOUGH
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a special attack, this Iron Golem always adds 2 automatic shields to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANT
powers.text: This Iron Golem never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and it does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

units.name: Iron Lich Viscerot
units.set: Revna's Rebuke: Iron Lich Viscerot and Necrotech Wraithriders

powers.name: DISMISSIVE STRIDER
powers.text: Iron Lich Viscerot can move through Small and Medium figures, does not take leaving engagement attacks from Small and Medium figures, and can target and attack non-adjacent figures while only engaged with Small and Medium figures.

powers.name: VILE INJECTION
powers.text: Begin the game with 3 yellow Surge Markers on this Army Card. Once per turn, before moving another Eisenek figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Viscerot, you may remove a Surge Marker from this card to add 2 to that figure's Move and Attack Values until the end of the turn.

powers.name: IRONCLAD PUPPETEER
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Viscerot and taking a turn with Viscerot, you may take a turn with another Unique Eisenek Hero or Squad you control.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Iron Man attacks, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Iron Man's movement, ignore elevations. Iron Man may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iron Man starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Isamu (1.0)
units.set: Fields of Valor: Heroes of Elswin

powers.name: VANISH 9
powers.text: If Isamu is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die to vanish. If you roll 1-8, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 9 or higher, Isamu takes no damage and may immediately move up to 4 spaces. Isamu can vanish only if he ends his vanishing move not adjacent to any enemy figures.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Isamu can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: DISHONORABLE ATTACK
powers.text: When attacking a figure who follows Jandar, Isamu rolls 2 additional attack dice.

powers.name: ETERNAL SERVITUDE
powers.text: Isamu cannot be destroyed by wounds on this Army Card except during the end of a round.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Isamu can move through all figures and never takes leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: LIFE DRAIN
powers.text: Each time Iskra Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Iskra Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.

powers.name: SUMMON THE RECHETS OF BOGDAN
powers.text: After taking a turn with Iskra Esenwein, you may attempt to summon the Rechets of Bogdan if they are in your army and they have not yet been successfully summoned. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you must place all 3 Rechets of Bogdan on empty spaces within 6 clear sight spaces of Iskra Esenwein. Any Rechets of Bogdan that you cannot place on the battlefield are immediately destroyed and cannot be summoned again. When the Rechets of Bogdan are summoned, you may immediately take a turn with them.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Iskra Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. Iskra Esenwein may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Iskra Esenwein starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

powers.name: SHOTGUN BLAST SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack. James only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. James cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

powers.name: WHIP 12
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, choose a small or medium figure adjacent to James. Roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the chosen figure cannot roll any defense dice if attacked by James this turn.

powers.name: EXOSUIT 15
powers.text: If Jarek Guy is attacked and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-14, roll defense dice normally. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore all damage that would be inflicted by the attack

powers.name: PLASMA GRENADE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 3. Lob 20. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. No clear line of sight is needed. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Plasma Grenade Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Jarek Guy can be affected by his own Plasma Grenade Special Attack.

units.name: Jeanne d'Arc
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Paragons of the New Alliance

powers.name: SHIELD OF FAITH 13
powers.text: If this figure would be affected by an attack, after attack dice are rolled, you may roll the 20-sided die. powers.name: FAITHFUL SPIRIT
powers.text: When Jeanne d'Arc is destroyed, you may place her figure onto a Unique Army Card. While she is on that Army Card, that Army Card gains the Shield of Faith 13 special power. If a figure from that Army Card rolls a 1-6 for Shield of Faith 13, remove Jeanne from that Army Card.

powers.name: REACH
powers.text: If an enemy figure is within 2 spaces of Jeanne, and its base is no more than 3 levels above Jeanne's height or 3 levels below Jeanne's base, you may add 1 to her Range Value when attacking that figure.

powers.name: JEANNE'S COMMAND
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Jeanne d'Arc, instead of taking that turn with Jeanne, you may take a turn with up to two Unique Human Knight or Fighter Army Cards you control. You may choose which one to activate first. Jeanne may be one of the chosen Army Cards. Any other figure that is taking a turn with Jeanne's Command must be within clear sight of Jeanne before moving.

powers.name: LOYAL ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Loyal figures adjacent to Jeanne d'Arc roll an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

powers.name: LAW OF THE LAND
powers.text: While there is another Lawman or Outlaw figure on the battlefield, Jim Whitecloud gains the class of Lawman in addition to what is listed on the card.

powers.name: TOMAHAWK 2
powers.text: If Jim Whitecloud is attacking an adjacent figure, add 2 dice to Jim Whitecloud's Attack.

powers.name: LASSO 11
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Jim Whitecloud, you may choose a small or medium figure within 3 clear sight spaces whose base is no more than 6 levels above Jim's height or 6 levels below Jim's base. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, place the chosen figure on an empty same-level space adjacent to Jim. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Lasso 11, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: LEARN FROM THE MASTER
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on and before taking a turn with this Squad, you may first take a turn with a Ninja Hero you control.

powers.name: COORDINATED TAKEDOWN
powers.text: While attacking, roll 1 additional attack die for each other friendly Ninja adjacent to the target.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Members of this Squad can move through all figures and never take leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: SHOTGUN BLAST SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Shotgun Blast Special Attack.
