Johnny cannot be affected by his own Shotgun Blast Special Attack.

powers.name: RAIN OF FLAME SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 7. Attack 1 + Special. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Rain of Flame Special Attack. Add 1 to Jorhdawn's attack dice for every additional Elf Wizard you control within 3 clear sight spaces of Jorhdawn, up to a maximum of +3 dice. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. Jorhdawn cannot be affected by her own Rain of Flame Special Attack.

powers.name: QUICK SHOT
powers.text: When Josie Whistlestop attacks, she may attack up to 2 additional times. Subtract 1 from Josie's Attack value on her second attack and subtract 2 from her Attack value on her third attack.

powers.name: WILD SWING SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by the Wild Swing Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Jotun cannot be affected by his own Wild Swing Special Attack.

powers.name: THROW 14
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, choose one small or medium non‑flying figure adjacent to Jotun. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, you may throw the figure by placing it on any empty space within 4 spaces of Jotun. The figure must land within clear sight of Jotun. After the figure is placed, roll the 20‑sided die for throwing damage. If you roll an 11 or higher, the thrown figure receives 2 wounds. If the figure is thrown onto a level higher than the height of Jotun or onto water, do not roll for throwing damage. The thrown figure does not take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Kaemon Awa
units.set: Dawn of Darkness: Heroes of Durgeth

powers.name: QUICK RELEASE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 4. Attack 4. When Kaemon Awa attacks with his Quick Release Special Attack, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

powers.name: SCAVENGER MOVEMENT COORDINATION
powers.text: After taking a turn with Kaijaax, you may move up to 3 Scavenger figures you control up to 5 spaces each.

powers.name: RADIOACTIVE
powers.text: Non-Dracostacean figures within 2 spaces of Kaijaax reduce their Defense Value by 1.

powers.name: INURED TO THE ELEMENTS
powers.text: Kaijaax may choose to ignore any effects from terrain he moves onto or occupies.

powers.name: SCORCHED EARTH SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 4.
All figures Kalagrith passed over this turn with her Flying special power are affected by Scorched Earth Special Attack. Kalagrith does not need clear line of sight to any affected figure. Roll 4 attack dice once for all figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately and no figures are considered to have height advantage. Figures under overhangs are not affected by Scorched Earth Special Attack.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Kalagrith's movement, ignore elevations. Kalagrith may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kalagrith starts to fly, if she is engaged, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: DISHONORABLE LEADERSHIP
powers.text:
When revealing an Order Marker on Kantono Daishi, after taking Kantono Daishi's turn, if Kantono Daishi is unengaged, you may take a turn with one of the following that you control:
• 1 Ninja Squad or
• up to 2 Ninja Heroes.
Any figure in the above list that is taking a turn with Dishonorable Leadership must be within clear sight of Kantono Daishi before moving.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Kantono Daishi can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against Samurai.

powers.name: FAN THE HAMMER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. Kate may attack that figure up to three times with Fan the Hammer Special Attack.

powers.name: TENACITY
powers.text: If Kate Crawford has 2 or more wound markers on her Army Card, add 1 to her defense dice.

units.name: Kato Katsuro (1.0)
units.set: Defenders of Kinsland: Heroes of the Molten Sea, Einar High Command Remastered

powers.name: KATO KATSURO'S COMMAND
powers.text: Instead of taking a turn with Kato Katsuro, you may take a turn with one of the following that you control: 1 Samurai Hero; or 1 Samurai Squad; or 1 Ashigaru Harquebus Squad and/or 1 Ashigaru Yari Squad. You may choose which Squad to activate first. Any figure in the above list that is taking a turn instead of Kato Katsuro must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro before moving.

powers.name: DAIMYO'S COMMAND
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Kato Katsuro, instead of taking a turn with him, you may take a turn with up to 2 different Unique Samurai Army Cards you control. Kato Katsuro may be one of these. Any other figure that is taking a turn with Kato Katsuro's Command must be within clear sight of Kato Katsuro to be activated.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When Kato Katsuro successfully defends against a normal attack from an adjacent figure that is not a Samurai, the attacking figure takes 1 wound from each excess shield.

units.name: Kee-Mo-Shi
units.set: Dawn of Darkness: Heroes of Durgeth

powers.name: MIND SHACKLE 19
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose any unique figure adjacent to Kee‑Mo‑Shi. Roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll a 19 or 20, take control of the chosen figure and that figure's Army Card. You now control that Army Card and all figures on it. Remove any Order Markers on the chosen figure's Army Card. If Kee‑Mo‑Shi is destroyed, you retain control of any previously Mind Shackled Army Cards.

powers.name: TOXIC SKIN
powers.text: After attacking, you must roll the 20‑sided die once for each figure adjacent to Kee‑Mo‑Shi. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure receives one wound. Soulborgs are not affectd by Toxic Skin.

powers.name: HEALING TOUCH
powers.text:
After moving and before attacking, choose a wounded hero figure adjacent to Kelda. Then roll the 20‑sided die to add or remove wound markers from the chosen figure's card:
•If you roll 1, add 2 markers.
•If you roll 2‑5, remove 1 marker.
•If you roll 6‑17, remove up to 2 markers.
•If you roll 18‑20, remove all markers.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Kelda's movement, ignore elevations. Kelda may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kelda starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: DOUBLE ASSAULT
powers.text: When Kha attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: POISON WEAPONS
powers.text: Each time Kha attacks a small, medium or large Hero with a normal attack or a leaving engagement attack and inflicts at least 1 wound, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-11, nothing happens. If you roll a 12 or higher, add 1 additional wound to the defending figure.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Kha is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

units.name: Kha-Re-Ga
units.set: Secrets of the Citadel: Might of the New Alliance

powers.name: HIVE TUNNEL
powers.text:
Instead of moving normally with Kha-Re-Ga you may Hive Tunnel. Choose an empty space within 4 spaces that is no higher than 6 levels above or below her level, and place Kha-Re-Ga on that space. Then, roll the 20-sided die for each figure adjacent to Kha-Re-Ga. Add 1 for each Wound Marker on this Army Card.
  • If you roll a 1-13, nothing happens.
  • If you roll a 14-19, that figure receives 1 wound.
  • If you roll a 20, that figure receives 3 wounds.
If Kha-Re-Ga is engaged when she starts to Hive Tunnel, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: RELENTLESS ASSAULT
powers.text: Each friendly figure adjacent to Khosumet with a relentless personality receives an additional attack die.

powers.name: UNLEASHED FURY ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: You may add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Unleashed Fury power on any Army Card.

powers.name: WITCHCRAFT TELEKINESIS
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose up to 2 different Small or Medium enemy figures within 5 clear sight spaces of Kilkorax the Kyrie Warrior. One at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each chosen figure. If the chosen figure is a Squad figure and you roll an 8 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. If the chosen figure is a Hero figure and you roll a 17 or higher, you may place the chosen figure onto a same-level space adjacent to Kilkorax. Figures moved by Witchcraft Telekinesis never take leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: BLUNDERBUSS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4. Attack 3.
All figures adjacent to the figure targeted by Blunderbuss Special Attack are also affected by Blunderbuss Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Killian Vane III cannot be affected by his own Blunderbuss Special Attack.

powers.name: EXPLOIT WEAKNESS
powers.text: At any point before, during, or after movement, you may choose one opponent's figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Kira Jax. All of the special powers on the chosen figure's army card (or cards if your opponent has more than one Common Army Card for that figure) are negated until the end of Kira Jax's turn. Kira Jax can only use Exploit Weakness once per turn.

powers.name: APPARITION
powers.text: Figures must be within two spaces of Kita the Springrunner to target her with a normal or special attack.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Kita can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: THE CAPTAIN'S WAY
powers.text: At the start of the game, choose a Unique Captain you control to be the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar's Captain for this game. Knaves of the Silver Scimitar roll one additional defense die against attacks from non-adjacent figures when their chosen Captain is within 4 clear sight spaces.

powers.name: CAPTAIN'S ORDERS
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Knaves of the Silver Scimitar, you may first take a turn with their chosen Captain or a Pirate Hero you control.

powers.name: FIRST ASSAULT 1
powers.text: When attacking with a Knave of the Silver Scimitar, if the defending figure was not adjacent to that Knave of the Silver Scimitar at the start of the turn, that Knave of the Silver Scimitar receives 1 additional attack die.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Knaves of the Silver Scimitar are never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: RUN 3
powers.text: Before moving Knight Irene, you may add 3 to her Move Value this turn. If you do, subtract 2 from her Attack Value this turn.

powers.name: OVERWHELM SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 1. Attack 3 + Special.
You may attack twice with Overwhelm Special Attack. If you attack the same figure a second time, you may roll an additional attack die for the second attack. You may not use Overwhelm Special Attack if you used the Run Special Power this turn.

units.name: Knight Primus Adelbern
units.set: Rising Tide: Knight Primus Adelbern & Ordo Borealis

powers.name: CRUSHING BLOW
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may inflict one wound on a Small or Medium Squad figure or a Small or Medium Common Hero adjacent to Primus Adelbern

powers.name: BLACKGAARD SURGE
powers.text: If no Knights of Blackgaard you control are engaged, you must subtract 3 from your initiative roll. If at least one Order Marker is on the Knights of Blackgaard, you may add 1 to your initiative roll for each engaged Knight of Blackgaard you control.

powers.name: RELENTLESS ARMY ATTACK BONUS
powers.text: If every Army Card you control has a relentless personality, each Knight of Blackgaard receives one additional attack die.

powers.name: DRACONIC STRATEGIC BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Knights of Scaeda you may first take a turn with a small, medium, or large Dragon or Dragonborn Hero you control. If you do not, then you may move up to 4 Knights of Scaeda you control and attack with any 2 of those Knights.

powers.name: ARCANE ARMOR 6
powers.text: When a Knight of Scaeda figure you control would be destroyed by anything other than receiving wounds from a normal attack, you may roll the 20-sided die before removing that Knight. If you roll a 6 or higher, that Knight is not destroyed and ignores all wounds just received.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for a Knight of Scaeda's movement, ignore elevations. A Knight of Scaeda may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Knight of Scaeda starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Knights of Weston
units.set: Knights of Weston Remastered, Utgar's Rage: Knights and The Swog Rider

powers.name: HUMAN CHAMPION BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the Knights of Weston, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.

powers.name: A COWARD'S REWARD
powers.text: Knights of Weston roll one additional die against figures leaving an engagement with them.

powers.name: CLEAR SHOT
powers.text: When attacking a figure that is not engaged, Koggo rolls 1 additional attack die.

powers.name: COWER
powers.text: After Koggo rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an opponent's figure, you may move Koggo up to 3 spaces, and Koggo no longer has any visible Hit Zones for the duration of the attacking figure's turn while he remains unengaged. Koggo will never take any leaving engagement attacks while using Cower.

units.name: Kolbjorn
units.set: Zawit's Doubt: Heroes of a Sundered Age

powers.name: FEARSOME STALKER
powers.text: After placing Order Markers each round, before rolling for initiative, if there is at least one Order Marker on Kolbjorn or another Tribesman Army Card you control, you may move Kolbjorn up to 3 spaces.

powers.name: GIANT SLAYER
powers.text: When Kolbjorn attacks a large or huge figure with a normal attack, add 1 attack die.

powers.name: CALL TO THE HUNT
powers.text: Once per round, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may choose any Hunter Army Card that has at least one figure you control within 8 spaces of Kolbjorn. Move any amount of unrevealed Order Markers onto that card from another card in your army with at least one figure on the battlefield.

powers.name: LEAPING ASSAULT
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, if Kon-Tar-Na moved less than 4 spaces, he may use Leaping Assault. Choose an opponent's figure within 3 clear sight spaces and place Kon-Tar-Na on any unoccupied space adjacent to the chosen figure. Kon-Tar-Na may not move more than 7 levels up or down using Leaping Assault. If Kon-Tar-Na is engaged when he starts his Leaping Assault, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: TASTE OF BLOOD
powers.text: Once per turn, after attacking, if Kon-Tar-Na destroyed an opponent's figure, you may attack one additional time with Kon-Tar-Na. Before the additional attack you may use his Leaping Assault special power.

powers.name: WOUNDED RAGE 13
powers.text: When Kozil receives one or more wounds from a normal or special attack but is not destroyed, you must immediately roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, inflict 1 wound on a figure adjacent to Kozil, if possible.

powers.name: CRUSHING GRASP 15
powers.text: After attacking with Kozil, if Kozil attacked a small or medium figure and rolled at least one skull and Kozil is still adjacent to that figure, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, inflict 2 wounds on that figure.

powers.name: CHARGING ASSAULT
powers.text: Any or all Kozuke Samurai may add 3 to their Move number as long as they are unengaged prior to moving. Kozuke Samurai must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Charging Assault.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

units.name: Krakenling
units.set: Embers of War: Krakenling & Gelryie Vanguards

powers.name: WARP SPACE
powers.text: Instead of moving normally, you may place a Krakenling on an empty space within 4 spaces. If a Krakenling is engaged when it starts to Warp Space, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ELDRITCH SWITCH
powers.text: After moving normally, a Krakenling may switch spaces with an adjacent single-space figure. Figures moved by Eldritch Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: FLAILING TENTACLES
powers.text: A Krakenling may attack up to 3 times on its turn. Reduce the number of attacks by 1 for each Wound Marker it has.

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: A Krakenling does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: INTO THE BASKET
powers.text: Krampus starts the game with a Krampus' Basket Glyph on his Army Card. After moving and before attacking, you may choose an enemy Small or Medium figure adjacent to Krampus and roll the 20-sided die. If the figure is Common and you roll a 5 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card. If it is Unique and you roll a 15 or higher, place that figure on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card.

powers.name: OUT OF THE BASKET
powers.text: After Krampus takes 1 or more wounds from an attack but is not destroyed, each player with 1 or more figures from their Army on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card may roll a 20-sided die. If they roll a 13 or higher, they may place 1 figure from their Army that is on your Krampus' Basket Glyph Card onto an empty space within 1 of Krampus, or the nearest empty space.

powers.name: STEALTH DODGE
powers.text: When a Krav Maga Agent rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, one shield will block all damage.

powers.name: WOUNDED SMASH
powers.text: When Krug attacks, he receives one extra attack die for each wound marker he has.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Krug attacks, he may attack one additional time.

units.name: Kumiko
units.set: Blackmoon's Siege: Heroes of the Moon Tribe

powers.name: NINJUTSU BARRAGE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. Instead of moving and attacking normally with Kumiko, you may move Kumiko up to 3 spaces. Kumiko can attack up to 3 times with Ninjutsu Barrage Special Attack at any point before, during, or after this move as long as Kumiko is on a space where she could end her movement. Kumiko cannot attack the same figure more than once on a single turn.

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Kumiko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

units.name: Kurrok the Elementalist
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Heroes of Khorvaire

powers.name: SUMMON ELEMENTAL
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Kurrok the Elementalist, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may if possible, place one of your previously destroyed small or medium Elementals on an empty space within 3 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

powers.name: MASTER OF THE ELEMENTS
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on Kurrok the Elementalist, instead of taking that turn with Kurrok, you may take a turn with up to three small or medium Elementals you control that are within 8 clear sight spaces of Kurrok the Elementalist.

powers.name: SONIC FISTS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4. Attack 5.
Choose a non-adjacent figure to attack that is not a destructible object and whose base is not higher or lower than 15 levels from Kursus' base. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Sonic Fists Special Attack. Kursus only needs a clear sight shot at the chosen figure. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking, immediately place Kursus on a space one of the destroyed figures occupied, if possible. If Kursus did not destroy a figure or cannot be placed, destroy Kursus.

powers.name: BOUND
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Kursus may use Bound. Bound has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Bound, ignore elevations. Kursus may bound over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and bound over obstacles such as ruins. Kursus may not bound more than 15 levels up or down in a single bound. If Kursus is engaged when he starts his bound, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: INCANTATION OF BOILING BLOOD
powers.text: Before moving normally with a Common Orc Squad you control, you may choose a figure in that Squad within 4 clear sight spaces of Kuthnak. For the rest of the turn, the chosen figure adds 3 to its Move and 1 to its Attack, and may attack any or all figures adjacent to it this turn with its normal attack. Roll each attack separately. After that turn, destroy the chosen figure.

units.name: Kyntela Gwyn
units.set: Fields of Valor: Heroes of Elswin

powers.name: STRENGTH OF OAK AURA 1
powers.text: All friendly Elves adjacent to Kyntela Gwyn add 1 to their defense dice.

powers.name: MOTORIZED ZIPLINE
powers.text: Start the game with 3 Zipline Glyphs on this card. Before and after moving normally, you may place up to 1 Zipline Glyphs on an empty space within 1 clear sight space of Lady Jaye.

powers.name: MASTER OF DISGUISE 14
powers.text: The first time each turn that Lady Jaye is targeted for an attack by a Squad figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, Lady Jaye cannot be targeted by that attack or any other attacks this turn.

powers.name: VYDAR'S RANGE ENHANCEMENT AURA
powers.text: All friendly figures with a Range number of 4 or more who follow Vydar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of Laglor add 2 to their Range number. Vydar's Range Enhancement Aura does not affect Laglor.

powers.name: AUTOLOAD SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 7. Attack 3. When attacking with Autoload Special Attack, you may roll Vydar Valkyrie dice. If you roll at least one Vydar symbol, you may attack again using Autoload Special Attack.

powers.name: BENDING REED STANCE
powers.text: If an opponent rolls at least 1 skull when attacking Lee Jun, if Lee Jun receives no wounds from that attack, place a Stance Marker on this card, up to a maximum of 3. After attacking with Lee Jun, you may remove 1 Stance Marker from this card to attack again.

powers.name: MELEE COMBAT EXPERT
powers.text: Lee Jun rolls one additional defense die for each opponent's figure he is engaged to, up to a maximum of +2.

powers.name: STEALTH LEAP 25
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Lee Jun may use Stealth Leap 25. Stealth Leap 25 has a move of 3. When counting spaces for Stealth Leap 25, ignore elevations. Lee Jun may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Lee Jun may not leap more than 25 levels up or down in a single leap. If Lee Jun is engaged when he starts his Stealth Leap 25, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Leslie "Coyote" Cane
units.set: Zawit's Doubt: Heroes of a Sundered Age

powers.name: AN EYE FOR AN EYE
powers.text: When Leslie "Coyote" Cane attacks, he may attack one additional time for each wound marker on this Army Card.

powers.name: OPPORTUNIST
powers.text: When attacking a figure that does not have any revealed Order Markers on its Army Card (or Cards if there is more than one Common Army Card for that figure), Leslie "Coyote" Cane receives 1 additional attack die.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Lilja attacks, she may attack one additional time.

powers.name: SHATTER POINT
powers.text: Lilja rolls 1 fewer defense die for each wound marker on this card to a maximum of 3 fewer defense dice.

powers.name: SHARDS
powers.text: If Lilja is attacked with a normal attack and receives enough wounds to be destroyed, you must roll 1 attack die, one at a time, for each figure adjacent to her. If you roll a skull, inflict one wound on that figure. Figures affected by Shards cannot roll any defense dice. After using Shards, remove Lilja from the battlefield.

powers.name: STEAL FROM THE RICH
powers.text: At any point while moving normally, you may choose a Treasure Glyph carried by a Hero adjacent to Locksley. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1–6, Locksley's movement ends. If you roll 7 or higher, place the Treasure Glyph on this Army Card and you may continue Locksley's movement. Locksley must be on a space where he can end his movement each time he uses this power.

powers.name: GIVE TO THE POOR
powers.text: Any Treasure Glyphs on this Army Card that are not Ancient Artifact Treasure Glyphs are treated as being on the Army Cards of all friendly Common Heroes within 3 clear sight spaces.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Locksley is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: BRAWLER
powers.text: If Louis "Mad Dog" Malone is engaged, add 1 to his attack dice and 1 to his defense dice.

powers.name: DOUBLE ASSAULT
powers.text: When Louis "Mad Dog" Malone attacks an adjacent figure or destructible object, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: BRUTALITY AURA
powers.text: When a Squad figure you control within 4 clear sight spaces of Loviatak the Kyrie Warrior attacks an adjacent figure with a normal attack, before defense dice are rolled, you may re-roll all attack dice that did not show skulls. Brutality Aura may only be used once per turn.

powers.name: DEADLY STRIKE
powers.text: When attacking with Loviatak, all skulls rolled count for one additional hit.

powers.name: DYNASTIC LEADERSHIP
powers.text: If you control Loviatak and another Unique Kyrie Hero who follows Utgar, figures you control who follow Utgar increase their Move Value by 1.

powers.name: CONCEALMENT 12
powers.text: If a Lurking Hive Soldier is targeted and would take 1 or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and that Lurking Hive Soldier. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 12 or higher, ignore those wounds.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: A Lurking Hive Soldier is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: PRIORITY TARGETING
powers.text: An engaged M-43 Resistance Fighter may target and attack non-adjacent figures unless that M-43 Resistance Fighter is engaged with a hero figure.

powers.name: GUERRILLA TACTICS
powers.text: After taking a turn with the M-43 Resistance Fighters, for each M-43 Resistance Fighter you control that attacked an opponent's figure this turn, you may move any Mariedian figure you control that did not attack this turn up to 3 spaces. A Mariedian figure may only be moved by Guerrilla Tactics once per turn.

powers.name: MISSILE BARRAGE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 6. Attack 3.
Choose up to two figures to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figures are also affected by Missile Barrage Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. M.A.R.S. can be affected by his own Missile Barrage Special Attack.

units.name: MacDirk Warriors
units.set: Jandar's Oath: Kilts and Commandos, MacDirk Warriors Remastered

powers.name: HIGHLAND FURY
powers.text: At the start of the game, choose a Human Champion you control. While that champion is in play, MacDirk Warriors roll one additional attack die for each wound marker on the chosen hero. There can be only one Human Champion for all the MacDirk Warriors you control. MacDirk Warriors cannot attack their chosen Human Champion.

powers.name: HUMAN CHAMPION BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with the MacDirk Warriors, you may first take a turn with any Human Champion you control.

powers.name: LIZARDFOLK WAR CRY
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Maekor and taking a turn with Maekor, if Maekor is engaged, you may immediately take a turn with one other Unique Lizardfolk Hero you control.

powers.name: MERCENARY DEFENSIVE FORMATION
powers.text: If Maekor is adjacent to at least one other Mercenary you control, add 1 die to the Defense of Maekor and all Mercenaries you control adjacent to Maekor.

powers.name: PLASMA BLADE ARC
powers.text: When Maekor attacks an adjacent figure that is not a destructible object, you may choose one Squad figure that is within 2 clear sight spaces of the defending figure. If the defending figure receives any wounds from Maekor's attack, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.

powers.name: SUNDERSTONE'S CHARGE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 4.
Instead of moving and attacking normally with Maeve Sunderstone, you may move her up to 3 spaces. Then, move Maeve up to 5 spaces in a straight line, passing through all figures and taking no leaving engagement attacks. After moving, roll attack dice once for all figures passed through. Each figure rolls defense dice separately in the order they were moved through. Defending figures never have height advantage against Sunderstone's Charge Special Attack.

powers.name: RUNEHAMMER OF MAEVE
powers.text: After Maeve makes a normal attack against a single-space figure, if the defending figure is still adjacent, you may move that figure 1 space. Figures moved this way do not take leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: BLOODFIRE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 2 + Special.
Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure except for this Mage of Scaeda are also affected by Bloodfire Special Attack. Add one automatic skull to whatever is rolled. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. After attacking with Bloodfire Special Attack, if any wounds were inflicted by the attack, this Mage of Scaeda receives 1 wound.

powers.name: ARCANE STEP
powers.text: Instead of moving normally with this Mage of Scaeda, you may place him on any empty space within 3 spaces of his current location and no more than 10 levels higher or lower than this Mage of Scaeda's base. If this Mage of Scaeda is engaged when he uses Arcane Step, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANCE
powers.text: This Mage of Scaeda never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and he does not have to stop on molten lava spaces.

units.name: Major Bludd
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: BLUDD'S BLASTER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 0 + Special. Explosion 1.
Add 2 automatic skulls to the attack roll. Major Bludd is not affected by his own Bludd's Blaster Special Attack. Bludd can use this attack only once per round.

powers.name: GUIDED CANNON SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 4. Attack 4. Major J15 may target and attack non-adjacent figures with his Guided Cannon Special Attack while engaged.

powers.name: BREACHING SCYTHE

powers.name: WARRIOR'S CHARGING SPIRIT
powers.text: When Manauvi is destroyed, place this figure on a Unique Army Card with a Range of 1. Manauvi's Spirit adds 2 to the Move number of that card.

units.name: Marachott, Mind Whisperer
units.set: Embers of War: Heroes of Arboreas

powers.name: COMMAND FAMILIAR
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Marachott, Mind Whisperer, before taking Marachott's turn, you may take a turn with a Small or Medium Beast you control.

powers.name: STAFF OF CURUPIRAN
powers.text: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Marachott always adds 2 automatic skulls to whatever is rolled.

powers.text: Each time Marcu Esenwein destroys a figure, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Marcu Esenwein cannot Life Drain destructible objects.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Marcu Esenwein's movement, ignore elevations. powers.name: SOLDIER LEADERSHIP
powers.text: All Soldiers you control move one additional space.

powers.name: SOLDIER ATTACK ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Soldiers adjacent to Marcus Decimus Gallus receive an additional attack die.

powers.name: MARIEDIAN TARGETING
powers.text: When a Mariedian Resistance figure attacks, it adds 1 to its Attack Value for each other Mariedian that attacked the targeted figure this Player Turn.

powers.name: GUERRILLA DEFENSE
powers.text: When a Mariedian Resistance figure defends, it adds 1 to its Defense Value for each other time a friendly Soldier has defended this Player Turn.

powers.name: WILD PACK MOVEMENT
powers.text: Before moving, roll the 20‑sided die. If you roll 1‑3, add 1 to the move value of this card. If you roll 4‑6, add 3 to the move value of this card.. If you roll 7‑20, add 7 to the move value of this card.

powers.name: MARRO PLAGUE
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you must roll the 20‑sided die once for each figure adjacent to any Marrden Hounds you control. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure receives a wound. Soulborgs and Wulsinu are not affected by this marro plague.

powers.name: HIVELORD LIFE BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Marrden Nagrubs, you may first take a turn with any Hivelord you control. powers.name: CELL DIVIDE

powers.name: SELF-REPLICATING
powers.text: Marro Hive cannot rebirth Marro Dividers with its Marro Rebirth special power.

powers.name: HIVE SWARM
powers.text:
Before moving Marro Drones, roll the 20-sided die.

If you roll a 13-16, you may move and attack with up to 6 Marro Drones you control.
If you roll a 17-20, you may move and attack with up to 9 Marro Drones you control.

powers.name: SWAMP WATER STRENGTH
powers.text: When a Marro Drudge is on a swamp water space, add 1 to its attack and defense.

powers.name: SWAMP WATER TUNNEL
powers.text: If a Marro Drudge ends its normal movement on a swamp water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level swamp water space within 5 spaces. If a Marro Drudge is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: CLING
powers.text: If a Marro Gnid inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's Unique Hero, you may place that Marro Gnid on the affected figure's card. powers.name: SCALE 1
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Marro Gnids may add 1 to their height.

powers.name: HIVE MIND

powers.name: MARRO REBIRTH
powers.text: After taking a turn with Marro Hive, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, you may place any previously destroyed Common Marro Squad figure from your army on an empty space adjacent to Marro Hive.

powers.name: STINGER DRAIN
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-4, you must destroy a Marro Stinger you control and you cannot attack this turn. powers.name: WATER CLONE
powers.text: Instead of attacking with all of the Marro Warriors, one at a time, roll the 20-sided die for each Marro Warrior. You may only Water Clone after you move.

powers.text: When Martial La Hire wounds a figure with his normal attack, he must attack one additional time, if possible.

Marutuk may not move normally out of engagement with an opponent's large or huge figure.

powers.name: DISMISSIVE SWIPE
powers.text: At any point while moving normally, if Marutuk is on a space where she may end her movement, Marutuk may choose an adjacent small or medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. powers.name: LONG STRIDES
powers.text: Marutuk can move through all small and medium figures.

powers.text: If there is at least one revealed Order Marker on this Army Card, then all Squad figures within 4 clear sight spaces of Masha Shingai must subtract 1 from their attack dice. Samurai are not affected by Terror of the Honorless.

powers.text: When Masha Shingai, or any Samurai or Yokai that you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Masha Shingai, receives one or more wounds from a normal attack by a figure that is not adjacent to the defending figure and Masha is not destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, the attacking figure receives one wound.

powers.name: SIFU
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Master Lao Xin, instead of taking that turn with Master Xin, you may take a turn with one Monk hero you control and either another Monk hero or a Monk Squad you control. powers.name: MASTER'S STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling attack dice for a normal attack, Master Xin always adds 1 automatic skull to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: STEALTH LEAP 25
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Master Xin may use Stealth Leap 25. Stealth Leap 25 has a move of 3. When counting spaces for Stealth Leap 25, ignore elevations. powers.name: MORTAL STRIKE
powers.text: After attacking an opponent's Unique Hero with this Master of the Hunt's normal attack, roll 1 attack die for each wound inflicted in that attack. For each additional skull rolled, place 1 additional wound marker on the defending figure's Army Card.

powers.name: JAVELIN

powers.name: MASTER'S INFLUENCE
powers.text: All Monk Squad figures you control may leap an additional 13 levels up or down when using their Stealth Leap special power. All Monks you control within 2 clear sight spaces of Master Woo add 1 to their attack dice and 1 to their defense dice.

powers.name: MASTER'S ASSAULT
powers.text: Master Woo may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

powers.name: FRENZIED SWARM 14

powers.name: EVASIVE 2

powers.name: FLYING

powers.name: STEALTH ARMOR 15

units.name: Migol Ironwill

powers.name: CLIMB X2
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Migol Ironwill may double his Height.

units.name: Mika Connour

powers.text: If Mika Connour starts her turn unengaged and on a shadow space, add 3 dice to her attack this turn.

powers.text: If Mika Connour starts her turn on a shadow space, instead of moving normally, you may place her on any other shadow space within 8 spaces of her current location. If Mika Connour is engaged when she starts her Shadow Dance, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.text: Mika Connour starts each game with up to 2 shadow tiles on her Army Card. If Mika Connour ends her turn on an empty land space, you may place a shadow tile from her Army Card onto the space she occupies if the shadow tile fits normally onto that space.

powers.name: HONOR AMONG THIEVES

powers.text: When counting spaces for Mimring's movement, ignore elevations. Mimring may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Mimring starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: TANK MOVEMENT

powers.text: Each time this figure destroys a figure, you may remove a Wound Marker from this Army Card. This figure cannot Life Drain destructible objects.

powers.name: LIFE DRAIN SPIRIT
powers.text: When Misaerx the Kyrie Warrior is destroyed, place this figure on the Army Card of a Unique Warrior Hero that follows Revna. That Hero now has Life Drain.

units.name: Mogrimm Forgehammer

powers.name: COMBAT LEADER
powers.text: If at least one order marker is on Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may add 3 to your initiative roll.

powers.name: COMMANDER'S STRIKE
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Mogrimm Forgehammer, you may choose any opponent's figure within 5 clear sight spaces that is engaged with any other figure you control. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.

powers.name: TOUGH
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, Mogrimm Forgehammer always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: BATTLE FURY
powers.text: If a Mohican River Tribesman is engaged, add 1 to his attack dice and 2 to his defense dice.

powers.name: WAR CRY
powers.text: After taking a turn with the Mohican River Tribe, if at least two Mohican River Tribesmen you control are engaged, you may immediately take a turn with one Unique Tribesman Hero you control.

powers.name: CONCEALMENT 19
powers.text: If a Mohican River Tribesman you control is targeted and receives one or more wounds from an attacking figure who is not adjacent, you must roll the 20-sided die. Count the minimum number of spaces between the attacker and the Mohican River Tribesman. Add this number to your die roll. If you roll a 19 or higher, ignore any wounds the Mohican River Tribesman just received.

powers.name: DWARVEN GUNNERS
powers.text: Instead of attacking with a Dwarf Squad figure you control that is unengaged and adjacent to Mok, you may remove that figure from the battlefield and place it on this card. There can be a maximum of two Dwarf figures on this card.

powers.name: GUNNER CASUALTIES
powers.text: If there is at least one Dwarf figure on Mok's card when Mok receives one or more wounds from an attack by a non-adjacent figure, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove one Dwarf figure from Mok's card and ignore any wounds.

powers.name: GUNNER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. After attacking normally, Mok may attack with Gunner Special attack once for each Dwarf figure on this card. While engaged, Mok may target and attack non-adjacent figures with Gunner Special Attack. Mok cannot attack the same figure twice with Gunner Special Attack.

units.name: Molten Crustaceans
units.set: Boiling Tensions: Molten Crustaceans & Tanuki Tricksters

powers.name: VOLCANIC CARAPACE
powers.text: Begin the game with three 1-hex lava field tiles and one 1-hex molten lava tile for every Squad of Molten Crustaceans in your Army. After a Molten Crustacean you control is destroyed by a normal attack, you must roll the 20-sided die and place one of these tiles onto the space that figure occupied, if the tile fits normally on that space. If you roll a 19 or higher place a molten lava tile, if able. Otherwise place a lava field tile.

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANT
powers.text: Molten Crustaceans are not affected by lava field or molten lava spaces, and do not have to stop their movement on molten lava spaces.

powers.name: CLIMB X2
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Molten Crustaceans may double their Height.

powers.name: BURNING BREATH SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 4 + Special. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose 4 spaces in a straight line from the targeted figure. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Moltenclaw is not affected by Burning Breath Special Attack.

powers.name: LAVA RESISTANT
powers.text: Moltenclaw never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage, and he does not have to stop in molten lava spaces.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Moltenclaw's movement, ignore elevations. Moltenclaw may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Moltenclaw starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: HIT AND RUN
powers.text: After taking a turn with Morgan's Riflemen, if none of the Morgan's Riflemen moved this turn, you may move each Morgan's Rifleman you control up to 5 spaces.

powers.name: VALIANT ARMY DEFENSE BONUS
powers.text: If every Army Card you control has a valiant personality, each Morgan's Rifleman receives 1 additional defense die.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Morgoloth attacks, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: SWARMING VERMIN
powers.text: Friendly small figures who follow Utgar or Valkrill are never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure within 5 clear sight spaces of Morgoloth.

powers.name: DEMON LEADERSHIP
powers.text: All Demons you control, except Morgoloth, move one additional space.

units.name: Moriko
units.set: Defenders of Kinsland: Heroes of the Molten Sea

powers.name: PHANTOM WALK
powers.text: Moriko can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: SABER STORM SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 1, 2, or 3. Moriko starts each turn with 6 attack dice. Choose any adjacent figure and attack by rolling 1, 2 or 3 attack dice. Moriko may keep making special attacks with 1, 2 or 3 attack dice until she has rolled all 6 attack dice. Moriko may target the same or different figures with each attack.

powers.name: PROMETHEAN CREATION
powers.text: Morinstein's Masterpiece does not start the game on the battlefield. He must be created by Dr. Torvin Morinstein.

powers.name: UNBELIEVABLE RAGE
powers.text: After taking a turn with a Scientist or Wizard Hero you control, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or higher, immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. If you roll a 1-3, you must choose another player to immediately take a turn with Morinstein's Masterpiece. After Morinstein's Masterpiece takes a turn with Unbelievable Rage, you cannot take another turn during that Player Turn.

powers.name: RESOLVE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, Morinstein's Masterpiece always adds 1 automatic shield.

powers.name: ROD OF NEGATION
powers.text: Start the game with 3 brown Negation Markers on this card. At the end of the turn, if you have at least 1 Negation Marker on this card, you may choose any opponent's unique figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Morsbane. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-15, nothing happens. If you roll a 16-19, place a Negation Marker on the chosen figure's Army Card. All of that figure's special powers are negated for the entire game. If you roll a 20, destroy the chosen figure.

powers.name: DREAD CHAIN GRAB 6
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Motley Max, you may choose up to two enemy small or medium figures within 3 clear sight spaces whose bases are no more than 6 levels above Motley Max's height or 6 levels below Motley Max's base. Roll the 20-sided die once for each figure. If you roll a 6 or higher, place that figure on any empty same-level space adjacent to Motley Max. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Dread Chain Grab 6, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ENGAGEMENT STRIKE 14
powers.text: If an opponent's small or medium figure moves adjacent to Motley Max, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 14 or higher, the opponent's figure receives a wound. Figures may only be targeted as they move into engagement with Motley Max.

powers.name: CALL LIGHTNING SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 6. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Call Lightning Special Attack. powers.text: When a Tombstone Gunslinger is targeted for a normal attack from an opponent's non-adjacent figure within 7 clear sight spaces of that Tombstone Gunslinger, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the opponent's figure receives 1 wound.

powers.name: SAMURAI LIFE DEBT
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on a Unique Samurai Squad you control that has at least one previously destroyed Samurai on its Army Card, before taking that squad's turn, you may first take a turn with Tomoe Gozen.

powers.name: DEFENSIVE FORMATION
powers.text: If Tomoe Gozen is adjacent to at least one other Samurai you control, add 1 die to the Defense of Tomoe Gozen and all Samurai you control adjacent to Tomoe Gozen.

powers.name: COUNTER STRIKE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits on the attacking figure. This power does not work against other Samurai.

powers.name: TRAMPLE STOMP
powers.text: At any point while moving, Tor-Kul-Na may choose a small or medium figure that is adjacent, on the same level, and on a space where Tor-Kul-Na may end his movement. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1 - 7, the figure is safe and Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. If you roll 8-20, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. If the wound destroys the figure, move Tor-Kul-Na on the space that the figure occupied, and you may continue Tor-Kul-Na's movement. If the chosen figure is not destroyed, Tor-Kul-Na's movement ends. Tor-Kul-Na must be on a space where he can end movement each time he uses this power.

units.name: Torin
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Heroes of Faerun

powers.name: BATTLEAXE
powers.text: If Torin is attacking a small or medium figure, add 2 dice to Torin's attack.

powers.name: EVIL EYE PROTECTION
powers.text: When Torin, or any friendly small or medium Utgar figure adjacent to Torin, rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent attacking figure, all excess shields count as unblockable hits inflicted by Torin on the attacking figure.

powers.name: DISENGAGE
powers.text: Tornak is never attacked when leaving an engagement.

powers.name: ORC WARRIOR ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: All friendly Orc Warriors adjacent to Tornak receive an additional attack die and an additional defense die.

units.name: Tul-Bak-Ra
units.set: Blackmoon's Siege: Heroes of the Moon Tribe

powers.name: MIND BLAST SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 3. Attack 3. Tul-Bak-Ra does not need clear line of sight to attack with Mind Blast Special Attack.

powers.name: TELEPORTATION
powers.text: Instead of moving Tul-Bak-Ra normally, you may choose any empty space that is on the same level and within 10 spaces of Tul-Bak-Ra. Place Tul-Bak-Ra on the chosen space. When Tul-Bak-Ra starts to Teleport, if he is engaged he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: TELEPORT REINFORCEMENTS
powers.text: When Tul-Bak-Ra receives one or more wounds from an opposing figure's Normal or Special Attack but is not destroyed, you may choose one friendly Marro Squad figure for every wound Tul-Bak-Ra just received. Place the chosen figure(s) on any empty space(s) adjacent to Tul-Bak-Ra. If the teleported figure(s) are engaged, they will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: NINJA CARRY
powers.text: Before moving normally with a Twilight Clan Rider, you may choose a friendly Small or Medium Ninja adjacent to that Rider. After you move that Rider, you may place the chosen Ninja adjacent to that Rider. Figures may only be moved by Ninja Carry once per turn.

powers.name: PHANTOM RIDE
powers.text: Twilight Clan Riders can move through all figures and never take leaving engagement attacks. A Twilight Clan Rider cannot move onto a space more than 3 levels above its level.

powers.name: TWILIGHT SLASH SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range Special. Attack 3.
Before attacking normally with a Twilight Clan Rider, that Rider may use Twilight Slash Special Attack. It may target any 1 figure it moved through this turn regardless of range, engagement, or line of sight. Figures never have height advantage against Twilight Slash Special Attack.

powers.name: DOUBLE ATTACK
powers.text: When Tyrian attacks, he may attack one additional time.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Tyrian's movement, ignore elevations. Tyrian may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Tyrian starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: GRIM DETERMINATION SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 4. If Grim Determination Special Attack does not destroy a figure, Ulfrid Hornwrangler receives a wound and must attack that figure again with his Grim Determination Special Attack, if possible.

powers.name: SHIELD OF VALOR
powers.text: When defending with Ulfrid Hornwrangler, each shield rolled counts for one additional block.

powers.name: MIND LINK
powers.text: Instead of taking a turn with Ulginesh, you may take a turn with up to 2 different Elf Wizards you control. Ulginesh cannot be one of the 2 Elf Wizards. Any Elf Wizard that is taking a turn instead of Ulginesh must be within 6 clear sight spaces of Ulginesh before moving.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Ulginesh's movement, ignore elevations. Ulginesh may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Ulginesh starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: BRINGER OF FLOODS
powers.text: While Uma the Cecaelia is within 6 clear sight spaces of a Wizard you control, all land spaces within 1 of Uma, including Uma's space, that are no more than 1 level higher or lower than Uma's level are considered water spaces instead of their normal terrain type.

powers.name: SWIM
powers.text: Uma does not have to stop her movement when entering a water space.

powers.name: MOB SWARM
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card and before taking a turn with Urk, you may move up to 8 Common Goblin figures you control up to 2 spaces each. Figures moved by Mob Swarm never take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: GOBLIN SNEAK ATTACK
powers.text: When attacking an opponent's figure, add 1 attack die for every Common Goblin figure you control that is adjacent to the defending figure, to a maximum of 3 additional dice.

powers.name: SCALE
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Urk may add 2 to his height.

powers.name: TROPHY SKULLS
powers.text: Once per round, when Uzog destroys an opponent's figure, you may place a Skull Marker on this card. If you do, Uzog cannot move normally for the rest of the round. A maximum of 2 Skull Markers can be placed on this card.

powers.name: GRUESOME DISPLAY
powers.text: When a figure engaged with Uzog defends against an attack from a Durgeth figure, the defending figure rolls one fewer defense die for each Skull Marker on this card.

powers.name: FIRST ASSAULT 3
powers.text: When attacking with Valguard, if the defending figure was not adjacent to Valguard at the start of this turn, Valguard receives 3 additional attack dice.

powers.name: BERSERKER CHARGE ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Berserker Charge power on any Army Card.

powers.name: SILVER BOLTS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 3. When a Lycanthrope or Hybrid figure receives one or more wounds from Silver Bolts Special Attack, that figure receives one additional wound.

powers.name: DIVINE MISSION
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on Van Nessing's Army Card, after taking Van Nessing's turn, you may reveal an "X" order marker that is on Van Nessing's Army Card and take another turn with Van Nessing. During this additional turn, Van Nessing adds 2 to his normal attack against Undead figures.

powers.name: HOLY RELIC
powers.text: When the 20-sided die is rolled for a special power on an opponent's Undead Army Card and at least one of the figures from that Army Card is within 3 clear sight spaces of Van Nessing, subtract 3 from the die roll.

powers.name: VARKAANAN BLADE DEFENSE
powers.text: A Varkaanan Blade Dancer rolls 1 additional defense die for each opponent's figure she is engaged to.

powers.name: DEFENSIVE VAULT
powers.text: After a Varkaanan Blade Dancer rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent opponent's figure, if she is still adjacent to the attacking figure, you may place that Varkaanan Blade Dancer on any other space adjacent to the attacking figure, if possible. A Varkaanan Blade Dancer does not take any leaving engagement attacks when using Defensive Vault.

powers.name: WOLF PACK
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Varkaanan Darkclaws' card, before taking that turn with the Darkclaws, you may choose one other Unique Wolf Army Card you control and take a turn with it. You may not attack with more figures from the chosen Army Card than the number of destroyed Varkaanan Darkclaws on this card.

powers.name: DUAL STRIKE
powers.text: When a Varkaanan Darkclaw attacks, he may attack one additional time. A Varkaanan Darkclaw cannot attack the same figure more than once per turn.

powers.name: SHADOW MASTERS
powers.text: A Varkaanan Darkclaw rolls 1 additional defense die while on a shadow space and 1 additional attack die when attacking a figure that is not a destructible object on at least one shadow space.

powers.name: WOLF PACK
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Varkaanan Greyspears' card, before taking that turn with the Greyspears, you may choose one other Unique Wolf Army Card you control and take a turn with it. You may not attack with more figures from the chosen Army Card than the number of destroyed Varkaanan Greyspears on this card.

powers.name: TRACKING
powers.text: While moving, the Varkaanan Greyspears may add 2 to their Move number. If they do, the Varkaanan Greyspears cannot attack this turn.

powers.name: WOLF PACK
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Varkaanan Quickblades' card, before taking that turn with the Quickblades, you may choose one other Unique Wolf Army Card you control and take a turn with it. You may not attack with more figures from the chosen Army Card than the number of destroyed Varkaanan Quickblades on this card.

powers.name: VAULT
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, any or all unengaged Varkaanan Quickblades may Vault. Choose an opponent's figure within 2 clear sight spaces and place that Quickblade on any unoccupied space adjacent to the chosen figure. A Quickblade may not vault more than 7 levels up or down in a single vault.

powers.name: LIGHTNING SLASH SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 3. A Varkaanan Quickblade that did not attack normally may use Lightning Slash Special Attack. Defending figures that were not adjacent to this Varkaanan Quickblade at the start of its turn subtract 1 from their defense dice for each skull rolled with Lightning Slash Special Attack.

powers.name: WOLF PACK
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on the Varkaanan Swiftfangs' card, before taking that turn with the Swiftfangs, you may choose one other Unique Wolf Army Card you control and take a turn with it. You may not attack with more figures from the chosen Army Card than the number of destroyed Varkaanan Swiftfangs on this card.

powers.name: FIRST STRIKE
powers.text: When Order Marker 1 is revealed on the Varkaanan Swiftfangs, add 2 to their Move number and 1 extra attack die for that turn.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Venoc Vipers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: FRENZY
powers.text: After you take a turn with Venoc Vipers, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher you may take another turn with Venoc Vipers.

powers.name: SCOUT LEADERSHIP
powers.text: All Scouts you control can move an additional 2 spaces.

powers.name: FRENZY ENHANCEMENT
powers.text: Add 1 to your die roll when you roll for the Frenzy Power on any Army Card.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Venoc Warlord does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: SPIDER SENSE 14
powers.text: If Venom is attacked by an opponent's figure and at least 1 skull is rolled, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-13, roll defense normally. If you roll a 14-20, Venom takes no damage and instead may immediately move using his Swing Line 4 Special Power.

powers.name: SWING LINE 4
powers.text: Instead of a normal move, Venom may use his Swing Line. Swing Line has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Venom's Swing Line movement, ignore elevations. Venom may swing over water without stopping, swing over figures without becoming engaged, and swing over obstacles such as ruins. Venom may not Swing Line more than 40 levels up or down in a single Swing Line. If Venom is engaged when he starts to Swing Line, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: WEB SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4. Attack 3
Figures roll 1 less defense die when defending against Web Special Attack.

powers.name: CLEAVE
powers.text: When a Veteran of Orleans attacks an adjacent figure, before rolling attack dice, you may choose 1 Squad figure that is also adjacent to that Veteran of Orleans. If the defending figure receives any wounds from that Veteran of Orleans's attack, the chosen figure receives one wound.

powers.name: A BROTHER'S CALL
powers.text: A Veteran of Orleans may add 1 to its Move number for each other engaged Human you control who follows Jandar, up to a maximum of +3 for A Brother's Call.

powers.name: SANGUINE SWORD
powers.text: Each time Viceron the Blood Knight destroys a figure with a normal attack, you may remove a wound marker from this Army Card. Viceron cannot use Sanguine Sword on destructible objects.

powers.name: BLOODSTORM RITUAL SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range Special. Attack 4. Bloodstorm Ritual Special Attack affects all figures within 2 clear sight spaces of Viceron the Blood Knight. Roll 4 attack dice once for all affected figures. All affected figures roll defense dice separately. Bloodstorm Ritual Special Attack does not affect Viceron. After attacking with Bloodstorm Ritual Special Attack, place a wound marker on this Army Card.

units.name: Vorid Glide Strikers
units.set: Rising Tide: Wing Commander Tuck Harrigan & Vorid Glidestrikers

powers.name: GLIDER LANDING
powers.text: Vorid Glide Strikers do not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing an Order Marker on this Army Card, you may place one Glide Striker from this card that has not been destroyed onto an empty space. You cannot place that figure adjacent to other figures. The placed figure cannot move normally this turn.

powers.name: EVASIVE 1
powers.text: Vorid Glide Strikers increase their defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

units.name: Vrono the Brambletooth
units.set: Embers of War: Heroes of Arboreas

powers.name: SHARP THORNS
powers.text: If an enemy Small or Medium figure moves onto a space adjacent to Vrono the Brambletooth where that figure could end its movement, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, the figure ends its movement and lowers its Attack Value by 1 until the end of the current turn. If you roll an 18 or higher, the figure also receives one wound.

powers.name: REDUNDANT SYSTEMS
powers.text: Start the game with 3 Redundant Systems markers on this army card. After a Vulcanmech Incendiborg receives one or more wounds, you may remove 1 Redundant Systems marker from this card to ignore all wounds.

powers.name: FLAMETHROWER SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range Special. Attack 4. A Vulcanmech Incendiborg that does not attack normally may use Flamethrower Special Attack. Choose 2 spaces in a straight line from the attacking Vulcanmech Incendiborg. All figures on those spaces that are in line of sight are affected by Flamethrower Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

units.name: Warden 816
units.set: Fields of Valor: Heroes of Elswin

powers.name: EVISCERAXE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 5. The Evisceraxe Special Attack cannot be used on small figures.

powers.name: GUARD LEADERSHIP
powers.text: All Guards you control move one additional Space.

units.name: Warforged Soldiers
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Veterans of the Last War

powers.name: TACTICAL SWITCH
powers.text: When a Warforged Soldier you control attacks an opponent's small or medium figure, before rolling the attack dice, you may switch that Warforged Soldier with the defending figure. After switching spaces, the Warforged Soldier must continue the attack, if possible, and cannot attack any other figure this turn. Figures moved by Tactical Switch never take any leaving engagement attacks. An opponent's figure may be moved by Tactical Switch only once per turn.

powers.name: WARFORGED RESOLVE
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal or special attack, a Warforged Soldier always adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.

powers.name: DEFENSIVE AGILITY
powers.text: When a Warrior of Ashra rolls defensive dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, one shield will block all damage.

powers.name: GRAPPLE RIFLE
powers.text: Instead of his normal move, Wastewalker Gage may use his Grapple Rifle. Grapple Rifle has a move of 4. When counting spaces for Grapple Rifle, ignore elevations. Gage may grapple over water without stopping, over figures without becoming engaged, and over obstacles such as ruins. Gage may not grapple more than 45 levels up or down in a single Grapple Rifle move. If Gage is engaged when he starts his Grapple Rifle move, he will take any leaving engagement attacks. If Gage used Grapple Rifle this turn, he may not attack a non-adjacent figure.

powers.name: CHAINSAW SWEEP SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 1. Attack 4.
Choose a figure to attack. You must choose a figure adjacent to both Gage and the chosen figure to also be affected by Chainsaw Sweep Special Attack, if possible. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. If you do not roll any skulls with Chainsaw Sweep Special Attack, Gage receives a wound.

units.name: Water Elemental
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Fury of the Primordials

powers.name: WATER MASTERY
powers.text: While a Water Elemental is on a water space, add 1 to its Attack and Defense.

powers.name: WATER TUNNEL
powers.text: If a Water Elemental ends its normal movement on a water space, you may immediately place it on any empty same-level water space within 5 spaces. If a Water Elemental is engaged when it starts to tunnel, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.

units.name: Werewolf Lord
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Veterans of the Last War

powers.name: LYCANTHROPY
powers.text: This Werewolf Lord starts the game with 3 green Lycanthropy markers on its Army Card. If an opponent's Unique Hero receives at least 1 wound from this Werewolf Lord, you may place a Lycanthropy marker on that figure's Army Card. For the duration of the game, that figure loses its Species, Class, and Personality. Instead, it has the following characteristics: Species: Hybrid, Class: Hunter, Personality: Tormented. Lycanthropy never affects Constructs, Lycanthropes, Soulborgs, and destructible objects.

powers.name: MOON FRENZY
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on this Werewolf Lord, before taking this Werewolf Lord's turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may first take a turn with any Hybrid Hero in play. If you take a turn with an opponent's Hybrid Hero, you control that Hero for the duration of its turn. At the end of its turn, control of the Hybrid Hero returns to its previous owner. All order markers that were on the figure's Army Card will stay on the Army Card.

units.name: White Wyrmling
units.set: Warriors of Eberron: Golem and Wyrmlings

powers.name: FLEDGLING ICE SHARDS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 5. Attack 2. When a White Wyrmling attacks with its Fledgling Ice Shards Special Attack, it may attack 1 additional time. It cannot attack the same figure more than once this turn.

powers.name: WYRMLING BONDING
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on a White Wyrmling Army Card, before taking that White Wyrmling's turn, you may take a turn with one other Wyrmling you control.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for a White Wyrmling's movement, ignore elevations. A White Wyrmling may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a White Wyrmling is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: ASCEND 4
powers.text: Instead of moving normally, the Wildwood Monarch may move one space. That space may be up to 4 levels higher.

powers.name: TRUNK OF THE AWAKENED FOREST
powers.text: After taking a turn with the Wildwood Monarch, you may take a turn with a small or medium Wildwood Hero you control.

powers.name: NATURE'S KEEPER
powers.text: Wildwood figures you control cannot attack other Wildwood figures you control.

powers.name: SEEDLING
powers.text: At the start of each round, before you place Order Markers, if you have not placed the Wildwood Monarch or used a Seedling power this round, you may place one of your previously destroyed small Wildwood Heroes on any empty space adjacent to the WIldwood Monarch.

powers.name: ASCEND 4
powers.text: Instead of moving normally, a Wildwood Runner may move one space. That space may be up to 4 levels higher.

powers.name: VIGOROUS GROWTH
powers.text: At the start of each round, before you place Order Markers, if you have not used a Vigorous Growth power this round, you may destroy one Wildwood Runner that was not placed this round and replace it with one of your previously destroyed medium Wildwood Heroes. Remove all wound markers from that Hero's Army Card.

powers.name: ASCEND 4
powers.text: Instead of moving normally, this Wildwood Sentinel may move one space. That space may be up to 4 levels higher.

powers.name: BRANCH OF THE AWAKENED FOREST
powers.text: After taking a turn with this Wildwood Sentinel, you may take a turn with a small Wildwood Hero you control.

powers.name: VERDANT GROWTH
powers.text: At the start of each round, before you place Order Markers, if you have not placed this Wildwood Sentinel or used a Verdant Growth power this round, you may destroy this Wildwood Sentinel and replace it with one of your previously destroyed large Wildwood Heroes. Remove all wound markers from that Hero's Army Card, then place wound markers on it equal to the number of wound markers on this card.

units.name: Wing Commander Tuck Harrigan
units.set: Rising Tide: Wing Commander Tuck Harrigan & Vorid Glidestrikers

powers.name: GLIDE IN 13
powers.text: Tuck Harrigan does not start the game on the battlefield. If Harrigan has not been placed on the battlefield, before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, place Harrigan on an empty space. You cannot place Harrigan adjacent to other figures, or on Glyphs. Then you may move any or all of your unrevealed Order Markers to this Army Card.

powers.name: EVASIVE 1
powers.text: Harrigan increases his Defense Value by 1 when defending against a non-adjacent figure.

powers.name: COIL CRUSH
powers.text: When attacking a small, medium or large figure, if Wo-Sa-Ga inflicts at least 2 wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, destroy the defending figure.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Wo-Sa-Ga does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces.

units.name: Wolves of Badru
units.set: Defenders of Kinsland: Soldiers and Wolves

powers.name: DARKLORD BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Wolves of Badru, you may first take a turn with any Darklord you control.

powers.name: CLIMB X2
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Wolves of Badru may double their height.

powers.name: POUNCE SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 3. Attack 5. A Wolf of Badru that moved but did not attack normally may use Pounce Special Attack. To pounce, choose a non-adjacent small or medium figure whose base is not higher or lower than 5 levels from the base of the attacking Wolf. If the figure is destroyed, immediately place the attacking Wolf on the space the figure occupied. If the figure is not destroyed, destroy the attacking Wolf.

units.name: Wyvern
units.set: Champions of the Forgotten Realms: Fury of the Primordials

powers.name: TALON GRAB
powers.text: While this Wyvern is flying, you may choose one opponent's small or medium figure that it passed over this turn. Place the chosen figure on an empty same-level space adjacent to this Wyvern at the end of its move. If the chosen figure is engaged when it is moved by Talon Grab, it will not take any leaving engagement attacks. Figures under overhangs can never be moved by Talon Grab.

powers.name: VENOMOUS STING
powers.text: When rolling attack dice, if this Wyvern rolls a skull on every die, the defending figure cannot roll any defense dice. Venomous Sting does not affect destructible objects.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for a Wyvern's movement, ignore elevations. A Wyvern may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Wyvern it engaged when he starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: SUMMON VINES
powers.text: Xenithrax starts the game with three Xenithrax Vines Glyphs on this Army Card. Once per round, after moving and before attacking, Xenithrax may choose an empty space within 4 spaces of Xenithrax and place a Xenithrax Vines Glyphs from this Army Card onto that space.

powers.name: ERUPTING EARTH SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5+ Special. Attack 4 - Special.
The first target of Erupting Earth Special Attack must be within a range of 5. After attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack, you may choose a figure that was adjacent to the defending figure at the beginning of that attack and attack that chosen figure with Erupting Earth Special Attack, rolling one fewer attack die. You may continue attacking with Erupting Earth Special Attack in this manner, rolling one fewer die than the previous attack, up to a total of four attacks. A figure cannot be attacked more than once in a turn with Erupting Earth Special Attack.

powers.name: AMULET OF PAIVATAR
powers.text: When a Kyrie you control who follows Ullar within 6 clear sight spaces of Xiamara the Kyrie Warrior receives one or more wounds, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8-16, ignore all but one wound just received. If you roll a 17 or higher, ignore all wounds just received. Amulet of Paivatar does not affect Xiamara.

powers.name: SWARMING
powers.text: After moving and before attacking with Xualtiaca Fire Ants, count the number of engaged Xualtiaca Fire Ants you control. You may move this number of unengaged Xualtiaca Fire Ants you control that you did not move this turn up to 3 spaces each.

powers.name: SWARM STING 18
powers.text: Instead of attacking, Xualtiaca Fire Ants may use Swarm Sting 18. Once for each opponent's figure adjacent to at least one Xualtiaca Fire Ant you control, roll the 20-sided die for stinging damage. Add 1 to your die roll for each Xualtiaca Fire Ant you control engaged with that figure. If you roll an 18 or higher, that figure receives one wound. If the wound was inflicted and the figure was not destroyed, roll again for stinging damage for that figure. Swarm Sting does not affect destructible objects.

powers.name: CLIMB X3
powers.text: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Xualtiaca Fire Ants may triple their height.

powers.name: SHADOW CAST SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 5. Attack 3 + Special.

If Xundar destroys an opponent's figure with Shadow Cast Special Attack, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Common Shadow figures.

powers.name: MASTER OF SHADOWS
powers.text: After revealing an Order Marker on Xundar, and instead of taking that turn with Xundar, you may move Xundar up to 5 spaces and then take a turn with up to three small or medium Common Shadow heroes you control that are within 8 spaces of Xundar.

powers.name: IRON SHIRT MASTERY
powers.text: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, if Yi Feng receives no wounds from the attack, the attacking figure receives one wound.

powers.name: STEALTH LEAP 25
