Yi Feng may leap over water without stopping, leap over figures without becoming engaged, and leap over obstacles such as ruins. Yi Feng may not leap more than 25 levels up or down in a single leap. If Yi Feng is engaged when he starts his Stealth Leap 25, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks

powers.name: MADDENING VISAGE
powers.text: After moving and before attacking, you may choose a figure within 6 clear sight spaces of Z'Thoth and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-10, choose an opponent. That player must move the figure 1 space, if possible. If you roll an 11 or higher, you must move the chosen figure 1 space, if possible. Figures moves by Maddening Visage take any leaving engagement attacks that apply.

powers.name: SHATTER MINDS SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text:
Range 4. Attack 3.
Choose a figure to attack. Z'Thoth does not need line of sight on the targeted figure. You may also choose one figure adjacent to the targeted figure to be affected by Shatter Minds Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for both figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: SLITHER
powers.text: Z'Thoth does not have to stop its movement when entering water spaces.

powers.name: GORILLINATOR ATTACK BONDING
powers.text: After revealing an order marker on Zaeus, you may take a turn with a squad of Gorillinators you control before taking a turn with Zaeus. The Gorillinators cannot move during this turn.

powers.name: RAIL GUN SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 7. Attack 4. When Zaeus attacks an opponent's figure that is not adjacent with his Rail Gun Special Attack, you must choose a figure adjacent to the targeted figure, if possible. If Zaeus inflicts more wounds than needed to destroy the targeted figure, all excess wounds count as unblockable hits on the chosen figure.

units.name: Zartan
units.set: G.I. Joe is There: Mission Specialists

powers.name: DESTRUCTIVE FORCE
powers.text: Adjacent figures reduce their Defense Value by 1 when defending against Zartan.

powers.name: PRIME OPPORTUNITY
powers.text: After Zartan destroys and adjacent figure, Zartan may make an additional normal attack. Zartan may continue attacking until he does not destroy an adjacent figure.

powers.name: CHAMELEON
powers.text: When an enemy figure attacks with a normal attack, if it can target a figure you control without the Chameleon Special Power, it cannot target a figure you control with the Chameleon Special Power.

powers.name: MAJESTIC FIRES SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 7. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. Any figures adjacent to the targeted figure are also affected by Majestic Fires Special Attack. Common Squad figures roll 2 less defense dice against Majestic Fires Special Attack. Roll attack once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Zelrig cannot be affected by his own Majestic Fires Special Attack.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for Zelrig's movement, ignore elevations. Zelrig may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Zelrig starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: DEADLY SHOT
powers.text: When attacking with Zetacron, each skull rolled counts for one additional hit.

powers.name: DETONATION SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 5. A Zettian Deathwing that moved but did not attack normally may use Detonation Special Attack. Any figures adjacent to the attacking Zettian Deathwing are affected by Detonation Special Attack. Roll 5 attack dice for all affected figures. Destroy the attacking Zettian Deathwing before each figure rolls defense dice separately.

powers.name: EVASIVE 2
powers.text: When a Zettian Deathwing rolls defense dice against an attacking figure who is not adjacent, add 2 defense dice to the defending Zettian Deathwing.

powers.name: FLYING
powers.text: When counting spaces for a Zettian Deathwing's movement, ignore elevations. A Zettian Deathwing may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Zettian Deathwing starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.

powers.name: HYPER SPEED BURST 3
powers.text: After moving and attacking with Zettian Deathwings, each Zettian Deathwing you activate this turn may move up to 3 spaces.

powers.name: ZETTIAN TARGETING
powers.text: When attacking, if your second Zettian Guard attacks the same figure as the first Zettian Guard, add one attack die to the Zettian Guard's attack.

powers.name: UTGAR SOULBORG BONDING
powers.text: Before taking a turn with Zettian Infantry, you may take a turn with any Soulborg Hero you control who follows Utgar.

powers.name: CIRCUITRY REPLACEMENT
powers.text: If a friendly Soulborg Hero who follows Utgar receives one or more wounds from a special power that is not an attack, you may destroy a guard in the Zettian Infantry you control that is adjacent to that Hero to ignore any wounds that Hero just received.

powers.name: SWORN ENEMY
powers.text: When attacking an opponent's Samurai or Ashigaru, Zhen Yuan rolls 1 additional attack die.

powers.name: EAGLE CLAW
powers.text: Before attacking with Zhen Yuan, you may choose an opponent's adjacent figure to attack with Eagle Claw. If the chosen figure receives one or more wounds from Zhen Yuan but is not destroyed, Zhen Yuan may attack the chosen figure one additional time. For the second attack, the chosen figure subtracts 1 from its defense dice for each wound received on the first attack. You may not use Whirlwind Assault if you chose a figure for Eagle Claw this turn.

powers.name: WHIRLWIND ASSAULT
powers.text: Zhen Yuan may attack any or all figures adjacent to him. Roll each attack separately.

powers.name: TRIBAL PROTECTION
powers.text: An opponent's figure that is engaged to one or more Warriors or Protectors you control who follow Ullar may not attack Zogross Hardscale.

powers.name: OPPORTUNITY STRIKE 15
powers.text: If an opponent's figure that is engaged with Zogross Hardscale targets any other figure you control with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, no dice are rolled for this attack, no defense dice are rolled, and the attacking figure receives one wound.

powers.name: HORDE SHRIEK
powers.text: After revealing an order marker and before taking a turn with this Zombie Hulk, if this Zombie Hulk is not engaged, you may first take a turn with another Undead Savage Hero or Squad that you control.

powers.name: PARALYZING FEAR
powers.text: Figures attacked by any Undead sutract one from their defense for every Zombie Hulk they are engaged to.

powers.name: ZOMBIE RISES AGAIN
powers.text: If an Undead Savage that you control destroys an opponent's large or huge figure, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Zombie Hulks, and remove all markers other than order markers on that card. Undead are not affected by Zombie Rises Again.

powers.name: HORDE MOVEMENT
powers.text: You may move up to 6 Zombies of Morindan that you control each turn. However, you may attack with only 3 Zombies of Morindan. You may attack with any 3 Zombies of Morindan, even Zombies of Morindan that you did not move this turn.

powers.name: ZOMBIE ONSLAUGHT SPECIAL ATTACK
powers.text: Range 1. Attack 6. Three Zombies of Morindan on the same level may combine their attacks and roll their attack dice as one attack. All Zombies of Morindan in the attack must be engaged to the targeted figure.

powers.name: ZOMBIES RISE AGAIN
powers.text: If a Zombie of Morindan that you control destroys an opponent's small or medium figure, replace that figure immediately, if possible, with one of your own previously destroyed Zombies of Morindan. Newly placed Zombies of Morindan cannot attack this turn. Undead are not affected by Zombies Rise Again.
